日月光投控財務長董宏思指出，隨著先進封裝與測試業務成長、產品組合改善，封測業務毛利率已經突破毛利率30%的結構性天花板上限，未來將成為新的營運基準底線，且除了高效能運算（HPC）帶動先進封裝需求，車用、工業應用回溫，加上AI周邊晶片需求，也有助於成熟封測業務成長。
半導體封測應用銷售分析來看，通訊營收比重38%、電腦34%，汽車、消費性電子及其他等合計28%；產品組合佔比，Bumping, Flip Chip, WLP & SiP佔51%、打線封裝24%、測試17%、材料2%、其它6%；前十大客戶營收佔半導體封測整體比重約63%。
電子代工服務(EMS)方面，第三季營收934.69億元，季增42%、年增35%；毛利率8.3%，季減0.6個百分點、年減0.9個百分點；營業利益31.11億元，季增98%、年增22%，整體系統級封裝(SiP)需求依然穩健，毛利率下滑主要受到AI建置潮引發的零組件成本上揚與轉嫁效應影響。
paras_en: Sun Moon Light Investment Holding (3711‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (29th) and released its Q3 financial results, reporting a post‑tax net profit of NT$26.996 billion, up 28% quarter‑over‑quarter and 148% year‑over‑year, or earnings per share of NT$6.13; cumulative net profit for the first three quarters was NT$62.19 billion, up 139.7% year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$14.17.

For Q3, Sun Moon Light posted revenue of NT$244.16 billion, up 27.8% quarter‑over‑quarter and 44.8% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 22.1%, an increase of 1.1 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 5.0 points year‑over‑year; operating profit was NT$33.14 billion, up 56.8% quarter‑over‑quarter and 151.1% year‑over‑year; operating margin stood at 13.6%, up 2.5 points quarter‑over‑quarter and 5.8 points year‑over‑year.

For the first three quarters combined, revenue reached NT$608.89 billion, a 30.3% year‑over‑year increase; gross margin was 21.2%, up 4.2 percentage points year‑over‑year; operating profit totaled NT$71.77 billion, up 117.0% year‑over‑year; operating margin was 11.8%, up 4.7 points year‑over‑year.

Looking at the performance of each business segment in Q3, the semiconductor packaging and testing (ATM) segment benefited from fully utilized advanced packaging (LEAP) capacity and a higher‑margin product mix, generating NT$151.485 billion in revenue, up 20.1% quarter‑over‑quarter and 51% year‑over‑year, with a gross margin of 30.6% (up 3.3 points quarter‑over‑quarter and 8 points year‑over‑year) and operating profit of NT$30.243 billion, up 53% quarter‑over‑quarter and 178% year‑over‑year.

Chief Financial Officer Dong Hong‑si noted that as advanced packaging and testing businesses grow and the product mix improves, the packaging segment’s gross margin has already broken the structural 30% ceiling and will become the new operational baseline. He added that, beyond high‑performance computing (HPC) driving advanced‑packaging demand, a rebound in automotive and industrial applications, together with AI‑related chip demand, will also support growth in mature packaging services.

In the semiconductor packaging and testing sales mix, communications accounts for 38% of revenue, computers 34%, and automotive, consumer electronics and other categories together 28%; the product mix is 51% Bumping, Flip Chip, WLP & SiP, 24% wire‑bond packaging, 17% testing, 2% materials and 6% other; the top ten customers represent about 63% of total packaging revenue.

In the electronic manufacturing services (EMS) segment, Q3 revenue was NT$93.469 billion, up 42% quarter‑over‑quarter and 35% year‑over‑year; gross margin fell to 8.3%, down 0.6 points quarter‑over‑quarter and 0.9 points year‑over‑year; operating profit was NT$3.111 billion, up 98% quarter‑over‑quarter and 22% year‑over‑year. System‑in‑package (SiP) demand remains robust, while the margin decline reflects higher component costs and pass‑through effects triggered by the AI build‑out wave.

items.title: 〈日月光法說〉Q4 營收估季增 6-8%、再度追加資本支出 LEAP目標上修明年可望翻倍
items.title_en: ASE Technology Holding Q4 Revenue Forecast Up 6-8% YoY, Additional Capital Expenditure, LEAP Target Raised with Potential to Double Next Year
paras: 半導體封測廠日月光投控 (3711-TW) 今(29)日召開法說，展望第四季，日月光投控預估，在 1 美元兌 31.9 元新台幣的匯率假設下，集團合併營收將季增 6% 至 8%；另因應先進封裝需求持續強勁，宣布2026年資本支出追加 10 億美元，由原先 105 億美元上調至 115 億美元，再創歷史新高。
展望第四季，日月光投控預估，在 1 美元兌 31.9 元新台幣的匯率假設下，集團合併營收將季增 6% 至 8%，毛利率估達 23% 至 24%，營益率則落在 14.5% 至 15.5%。半導體封測（ATM）事業營收預計季增 11% 至 13%，毛利率將再提升 1 至 2 個百分點；電子代工服務（EMS）事業營收則估持平，營益率約 2%。
其中，在先進封裝與測試（LEAP）方面，受惠客戶需求強勁、產能建置進度優於預期，日月光投控將 2026 年 LEAP 營收目標由原先 37 億美元上修至逾 40 億美元；財務長董宏思表示，目前產能仍無法完全滿足市場需求，公司將持續擴充產能，預期 2027 年 LEAP 營收規模可望再翻倍。
市場關注的先進封裝全製程（Full-process CoWoS）方面，日月光投控預估，2026 年營收可達 3 億美元，2027 年則可望突破 10 億美元，隨著良率達到量產出貨水準，相關業務將進一步成長。此外，CPO 產品預計今年第四季進入量產，2027 年相關營收可望超過 5 億美元，並納入 LEAP 業務計算。
為因應產能擴充需求，日月光投控今年新增 10 億美元資本支出，將分別投入廠房設施及機器設備，兩者各占約一半；設備投資中，約 60% 將用於先進封測專案，其餘則投入主流產品。目前全台共有 22 座廠房專案持續推進，超過半數建案預計自今年起至 2027 年陸續開出產能，公司也正積極尋找合適的既有廠房，以加快產能擴充。
paras_en: Semiconductor packaging and testing company ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) held an earnings briefing today (29th). Looking ahead to Q4, ASE estimates that, assuming an exchange rate of NT$31.9 per US$1, the group's consolidated revenue will grow 6% to 8% quarter‑over‑quarter; in response to continued strong demand for advanced packaging, it announced an additional US$1 billion of capital spending for 2026, raising the total from US$10.5 billion to US$11.5 billion, a new historic high.

Looking into Q4, ASE projects that, under the same NT$31.9 per US$1 assumption, consolidated revenue will rise 6%‑8% quarter‑over‑quarter, with gross margin estimated at 23%‑24% and operating margin at 14.5%‑15.5%. Revenue from the semiconductor assembly and test (ATM) business is expected to increase 11%‑13% quarter‑over‑quarter, with gross margin improving another 1‑2 percentage points; revenue from the electronic manufacturing services (EMS) business is expected to be flat, with an operating margin of about 2%.

In the advanced packaging and testing (LEAP) segment, benefiting from strong customer demand and faster‑than‑expected capacity build‑out, ASE raised its 2026 LEAP revenue target from US$3.7 billion to over US$4 billion. CFO Dong Hong‑si said capacity is still not fully able to meet market demand, and the company will continue to expand capacity, expecting LEAP revenue in 2027 to potentially double again.

Regarding the market‑focused full‑process CoWoS advanced packaging, ASE estimates 2026 revenue could reach US$300 million and 2027 could break US$1 billion as yields reach mass‑production levels, driving further growth. In addition, the CPO product is slated to enter volume production in Q4 this year, with related 2027 revenue expected to exceed US$500 million and be counted within the LEAP business.

To support capacity expansion, ASE added US$1 billion of capital expenditure this year, split roughly equally between plant facilities and equipment. About 60% of equipment spending will go to advanced packaging projects, with the remainder allocated to mainstream products. Currently, 22 plant projects across Taiwan are underway, with more than half slated to come online from this year through 2027, and the company is actively seeking suitable existing facilities to accelerate capacity growth.

items.title: 〈瑞昱法說〉Q4淡季不淡、Wi-Fi 8明年下半年放量 2030年HPC及邊緣AI營收占比拚3成
items.title_en: Realtek Earnings Call: Q4 Not Slow Despite Seasonality, Wi‑Fi 8 to Ramp Up in H2 2027, Aim for >30% HPC and Edge AI Revenue Share by 2030
paras: 網通晶片廠瑞昱(2379-TW)今(29)日舉行法說會，瑞昱表示，受惠高規格產品組合及價格調整帶動平均售價(ASP)提升，第四季營運有望淡季不淡，即使PC需求進一步走弱，營收仍可能避免往常的季節性放緩。展望2027年，公司預期營收將穩健成長，並持續布局Wi-Fi 8、車載乙太網路、高速傳輸及邊緣AI等應用，其中Wi-Fi 8解決方案預計明年下半年開始放量。
針對第四季營運展望，瑞昱指出，整體營運動能目前維持穩定，較佳的產品組合及價格調整帶動平均售價提升，將有助抵銷部分PC需求走弱的影響。不過，晶圓代工與封測成本持續上漲，以及供應鏈產能分配仍是重要外部變數，公司將持續與供應鏈夥伴及客戶協調，並採取審慎的定價策略。
展望2027年，瑞昱維持營收穩健成長的看法，主要動能來自平均售價提升、產品規格升級及新產品推出。公司也將在維持毛利率穩定的前提下，兼顧營收成長、市占率與獲利能力。
在無線連網技術方面，瑞昱表示，Wi-Fi 7在個人電腦與路由器市場的滲透率預計今年達約30%，2027年可望進一步提升至約40%。至於次世代Wi-Fi 8，公司持續參與前期測試及規格制定，認證測試計畫目標於2027年6月完成，官方認證預計同年9月啟動，旗下解決方案則將於2027年下半年開始放量，2028年客戶採用可望更加廣泛。
車載與實體AI方面，瑞昱指出，車載乙太網路在全球新車市場的滲透率已突破50%。儘管整體汽車出貨量大致持平，但隨著車廠轉向區域控制架構，每車乙太網路連接埠數增加，有助推升單車晶片價值。瑞昱持續拓展車用乙太網路交換器及閘道控制器產品，並已獲全球車廠及一線供應商設計導入。
機器人方面，由於內部連網技術與車載應用具有高度相容性，瑞昱連網解決方案已導入第一波主要商用機器人，並與全球領先的人形機器人開發商合作，供應原型機及早期導入專案，持續布局實體AI應用。
在高速傳輸與雲端運算方面，瑞昱表示，多千兆乙太網路解決方案占整體乙太網路營收比重已超過40%。隨著本地端大型語言模型(LLM)運算需求增加，終端電腦也持續升級至5G、10G乙太網路規格。光通訊方面，100G光學實體層(PHY)晶片正進行客戶認證，預期2027年放量將更為顯著；400G與800G PAM4數位訊號處理器(DSP)則按計畫開發，預計2027年下半年推出。
瑞昱進一步指出，目前高效能運算(HPC)與邊緣AI相關業務占總營收比重為高個位數百分比，涵蓋車用、機器人及相關運算應用。公司設定中長期目標，預計至2030年將高效能運算與邊緣AI營收占比提升至30%以上，並持續拓展乙太網路、交換器、儲存控制器及高速互連等產品在AI伺服器與基礎設施的應用。
paras_en: Realtek (2379‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (29th). The company said that thanks to a high‑spec product mix and price adjustments that lifted average selling price (ASP), Q4 operations are expected to avoid the usual seasonal slowdown. Even if PC demand weakens further, revenue may still dodge the typical seasonal dip. Looking ahead to 2027, the firm expects steady revenue growth and continues to invest in Wi‑Fi 8, automotive Ethernet, high‑speed transport and edge AI applications, with Wi‑Fi 8 solutions slated to scale from the second half of next year.

Regarding the Q4 outlook, Realtek noted that overall operating momentum remains stable. A better product mix and price adjustments that raise ASP will help offset some of the impact from weaker PC demand. However, rising wafer‑foundry and test‑pack costs, as well as supply‑chain capacity allocation, remain key external variables. The company will keep coordinating with supply‑chain partners and customers and will adopt a prudent pricing strategy.

Looking to 2027, Realtek maintains its view of steady revenue growth, driven mainly by higher ASPs, upgraded product specifications and new product launches. The firm will aim to keep gross margins stable while balancing revenue growth, market share and profitability.

In wireless networking, Realtek said Wi‑Fi 7 penetration in PCs and routers is expected to reach about 30% this year and roughly 40% by 2027. For next‑generation Wi‑Fi 8, the company continues early‑stage testing and specification work, targeting certification test completion by June 2027, official certification in September 2027, and volume production of its solutions starting in the second half of 2027, with broader customer adoption anticipated in 2028.

On automotive and physical AI, Realtek noted that automotive Ethernet penetration in the global new‑car market has already exceeded 50%. Although overall vehicle shipments are roughly flat, automakers are shifting to zone‑control architectures, increasing the number of Ethernet ports per vehicle and boosting per‑car chip value. Realtek is expanding its automotive Ethernet switch and gateway controller portfolio and has secured design adoption from global OEMs and tier‑1 suppliers.

Regarding robotics, because its internal networking technology is highly compatible with automotive applications, Realtek’s networking solutions have been incorporated into the first wave of major commercial robots. The company is also working with leading humanoid robot developers to supply prototype units and early‑stage deployment projects, further building out physical‑AI use cases.

In high‑speed transport and cloud computing, Realtek said multi‑gigabit Ethernet solutions now account for over 40% of total Ethernet revenue. As demand for on‑premise large language model (LLM) processing grows, end‑point devices are upgrading to 5G and 10G Ethernet specs. In optics, its 100G optical PHY chip is undergoing customer qualification, with volume expected to rise sharply in 2027; 400G and 800G PAM4 digital signal processors are on schedule, slated for release in the second half of 2027.

Realtek added that today its high‑performance computing (HPC) and edge‑AI businesses represent a high‑single‑digit percentage of total revenue, covering automotive, robotics and related compute applications. The company has set a mid‑to‑long‑term goal to lift the share of HPC and edge‑AI revenue to over 30% by 2030, while continuing to expand Ethernet, switch, storage controller and high‑speed interconnect products for AI servers and infrastructure.

items.title: 集邦：MacBook Pro新機入局 估2027年全球OLED筆電出貨年增逾40%
items.title_en: TrendForce: New MacBook Pro Enters Market, Forecasts Over 40% YoY Growth in Global OLED Laptop Shipments by 2027
paras: 研調機構TrendForce最新研究指出，Apple甫發表的MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display首度導入串聯式OLED觸控螢幕，標誌MacBook顯示技術與操作體驗的重要轉變。TrendForce預估，這款新機於2027年的出貨量將介於120-150萬台間，Apple切入OLED筆電市場，也已激勵面板廠加速相關顯示技術發展。
TrendForce分析，由於MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display起售價達2,899美元(14吋)，且初期與既有Mini-LED機種雙軌銷售，預料高價定位與產品重疊將限制短期換機動能。不過，新機進一步鞏固Apple高階產品的技術形象與溢價定位，搭配入門級MacBook Neo採取不同於以往的價格策略，反映Apple產品逐步覆蓋更廣泛的價格帶。
對OLED筆電市場而言，過去主力為Lenovo、HP、ASUS等Windows品牌，產品布局已逐步延伸至不同價位。Apple的加入有望促使品牌優先規劃OLED機種，以及提高消費者對OLED筆電的接受度，為擴大面板技術應用創造空間。TrendForce預估，即使整體筆電市場近兩年皆呈現衰退，2026年OLED筆電整機出貨量仍可望年增近40%，2027年將再成長40%以上。
目前MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display的面板由Samsung Display(SDC)獨家供應，該公司已規畫韓國牙山園區的G8.6 A6產線Phase1為Apple專線。作為其G8.6 FMM OLED產線量產的第一支model，且用於Apple進入OLED筆電的第一台、最高端旗艦機，對SDC宣示OLED市場的領先地位有指標意義。

TrendForce表示，由於MacBook Pro新機採用Tandem OLED疊層架構，且每英吋像素(PPI)達254，高規格要求對上游面板廠的材料成本、良率都是極大挑戰。因此，即便其他面板廠也有驗證項目在進行，但考量成本架構過高，加上SDC已取得第一供應商地位，LG Display、BOE、TCL CSOT等其餘OLED面板廠目前主要目標是進入MacBook Air OLED供應鏈，該機種預計於2029年發表。
paras_en: TrendForce’s latest research indicates that Apple’s newly announced MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display introduces a serial‑connected OLED touch screen for the first time, marking a significant shift in MacBook display technology and user experience. TrendForce estimates that shipments of this new model in 2027 will range between 1.2 million and 1.5 million units, and Apple’s entry into the OLED laptop market has already spurred panel makers to accelerate related display‑technology development.

TrendForce analysis notes that, with a starting price of US$2,899 for the 14‑inch model and a dual‑track sales strategy alongside existing Mini‑LED variants, the high‑price positioning and product overlap are expected to limit short‑term upgrade momentum. Nevertheless, the new model further reinforces Apple’s high‑end technical image and premium pricing, while the entry‑level MacBook Neo adopts a different pricing strategy, reflecting Apple’s gradual coverage of a broader price spectrum.

For the OLED laptop market, the main players have historically been Windows brands such as Lenovo, HP and ASUS, whose product line‑ups have gradually expanded across price tiers. Apple’s participation is expected to prompt brands to prioritize OLED models and raise consumer acceptance of OLED laptops, creating space for broader panel‑technology applications. TrendForce projects that even though the overall laptop market has been declining for the past two years, OLED laptop shipments in 2026 can still grow by nearly 40% year‑over‑year, and growth will exceed another 40% in 2027.

The display panel for the current MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is supplied exclusively by Samsung Display (SDC), which has planned a dedicated Apple line on its G8.6 A6 production line (Phase 1) at the Yashan campus in Korea. As the first model on SDC’s G8.6 FMM OLED production line and the flagship device for Apple’s entry into OLED laptops, it serves as a benchmark indicating SDC’s leading position in the OLED market.

TrendForce says that the new MacBook Pro uses a tandem OLED stack architecture with a pixel density of 254 PPI, presenting a major challenge for upstream panel makers in terms of material costs and yields. Consequently, although other panel manufacturers have verification projects underway, the high cost structure and SDC’s status as the primary supplier limit their prospects. LG Display, BOE, TCL‑CSOT and other OLED panel makers are now mainly targeting the MacBook Air OLED supply chain, with that model expected to be announced in 2029.

items.title: 竹科廠火警 嘉晶：占總產能比率低於10％以下 營運無重大影響
items.title_en: Hsinchu Science Park Plant Fire Jaci: Affected Capacity Ratio Below 10% with No Significant Operational Impact
paras: 第三代半導體廠嘉晶(3016-TW)昨(28)日位於新竹科學學園區的「嘉晶電子創新廠」慘遭祝融。嘉晶今(29)日表示，事故後即刻啟動緊急應變機制，無任何人員傷亡，對公司財務及整體營運並無重大影響，本次受影響嘉晶五座廠區中其中一座廠，此次影響為4、5吋磊晶產線，占總產值與總產能之比率低於10%。
嘉晶表示，火災事故發生後，公司即刻啟動緊急應變機制，同步通報消防單位趕赴現場處置，並迅速將該區域所有工作人員安全撤離，現場無任何人員受傷或受困，本次受影響區域為公司五座生產廠區中的其中一座廠，該廠主要生產4、5吋及部分6、8吋產品，占公司整體總產值與總產能之比率低於10%。
嘉晶指出，經初步評估災情事故，主要影響為4、5吋磊晶產線，至於6、8吋磊晶設備受電力影響，機台復原時間目前推估約需1至2周時間，公司將以快速復工為最優先目標，之後將持續進行清理及恢復廠務設施影響較低部分。
嘉晶也同步啟動各廠區之間的產能調度與備援機制，將客戶交期與營運影響降至最低，預計復工後，產能較吃緊的6、8吋產能可完全恢復。
針對本次事件，嘉晶也向新竹縣、市消防局及警消、義消同仁表達最誠摯的感謝，感謝消防隊員於第一時間迅速抵達現場、掌控火勢，以最高效率確保廠區人員安全並防止災害擴大，另對火災時的煙霧造成附近公司員工及居民困擾，亦深表歉意。
嘉晶強調，後續將全力配合主管機關進行事故原因之調查，同時完成廠區設備之安全檢查與復工，公司資產均已投保足額商業財產及營業中斷全額保險，本次事件對公司財務及整體營運並無重大影響。
paras_en: On the 28th, Jaci (3016‑TW), a third‑generation semiconductor manufacturer, suffered a severe fire at its "Jaci Electronics Innovation Plant" in the Hsinchu Science Park. The company said on the 29th that it immediately activated its emergency response plan, there were no injuries, and the incident has no material impact on its finances or overall operations. The fire affected one of Jaci’s five factories, specifically the 4‑inch and 5‑inch wafer production line, which accounts for less than 10% of total output and capacity.

Jaci stated that after the fire broke out, the company promptly triggered its emergency response mechanism, notified fire services who rushed to the scene, and quickly evacuated all personnel from the area. No one was injured or trapped. The affected area is one of the five production sites, mainly producing 4‑inch, 5‑inch and some 6‑inch and 8‑inch products, representing less than 10% of the company’s total output and capacity.

Jaci indicated that a preliminary assessment shows the main impact is on the 4‑inch and 5‑inch wafer lines. The 6‑inch and 8‑inch equipment suffered power issues, and restoration of those machines is estimated to take about one to two weeks. The company will prioritize rapid resumption of work and will continue cleaning and restoring less‑affected facilities.

Jaci also activated capacity scheduling and backup mechanisms across its plants to minimize customer delivery delays and operational impact. After resuming production, the tighter‑supply 6‑inch and 8‑inch capacity is expected to be fully restored.

Regarding the incident, Jaci expressed sincere gratitude to the Hsinchu County and City fire bureaus, as well as volunteer and rescue firefighters, for arriving promptly, controlling the blaze, ensuring personnel safety, and preventing further damage. The company also apologizes for the smoke inconvenience caused to nearby employees and residents.

Jaci emphasized that it will fully cooperate with regulators in investigating the cause, complete safety inspections of plant equipment, and resume operations. All assets are fully insured for commercial property and business interruption, and the event has no material impact on the company’s financials or overall operations.

items.title: 不押誰的AI最強！華爾街搶當房東 靠科技巨頭長約收租
items.title_en: Who Has the Strongest AI? Wall Street Rushes to Become Landlords, Relying on Tech Giants for Long-Term Rent
paras: AI基礎建設投資熱潮持續，華爾街大型另類資產管理公司正透過持有資料中心、簽訂長期租約，參與這波擴張。面對市場擔憂高負債的新型雲端業者可能違約，以及龐大AI支出未必帶來足夠回報，業者強調，其策略重點在於實體資產、長期租金收入，以及信用良好的大型科技租戶。
《路透》報導，Blue Owl(OWL-US)共同執行長Marc Lipschultz表示，公司持有數位經濟成長不可或缺的實體基礎設施，通常以15至20年租約出租，並約定租金逐年調升，為投資人創造可預測且持續成長的收入。他強調，公司著重限制短期租約與AI詞元(token)定價等相關風險。
另類資產管理業者周四(29日)盤中股價走高，Blue Owl上漲6.5%，Ares Management(ARES-US)上漲2%，KKR(KKR-US)與黑石集團(BX-US)各漲2.5%，阿波羅全球管理(APO-US)則上漲3.7%。

鎖定大型科技租戶 以長約確保收入

資料中心容納訓練與運行AI模型所需的伺服器及運算設備。隨著大型科技公司競相擴充算力，相關設施需求大增，被另類資產管理業者視為一個世代難得一見的投資機會。
Blue Owl表示，目前營運中或興建中的資料中心超過130座，已承租與自有容量合計近14吉瓦(GW)，另有21吉瓦的潛在開發項目。
Blue Owl財務長Alan Kirshenbaum表示，公司投資資料中心，並不是直接押注AI產業的勝負，而是承擔微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與Meta(META-US)等租戶的信用風險。他也表示，公司不預期運算需求會下降。
Ares的資料中心開發策略則聚焦東京、大阪、倫敦與聖保羅等都會區，事先將開發案出租給具投資等級信用的超大規模雲端業者。租約期限為12至15年，不賦予租戶提前終止權，並設有隨通膨調升租金的條款。
黑石上周也強調，其布局重點為實體基礎設施與長期合約資產。旗下絕大多數資料中心的初始租期為15至20年，96%的交易對手具投資等級信用評等，平均市值達2.5兆美元。
黑石總裁Jonathan Gray在財報電話會議上表示，從這些條件來看，公司並不認為相關投資風險特別高。

AI融資需求擴大 私募信貸承接更多資金缺口

涵蓋資料中心、電力、設備與軟體的AI支出，被視為歷來規模最大的投資浪潮之一，可與網際網路興起及鐵路擴張時期相比。
Ares估計，截至2030年，AI相關資本支出需求將略超過5兆美元，其中約2兆美元用於資料中心建築，以及周邊發電與輸電基礎設施。
針對本月稍早的AI相關資產拋售，Ares執行長Michael Arougheti表示，投資人正更仔細區分交易對手風險，並重新評估應如何定價。他也淡化借款成本上升對AI建設融資的影響，指出業者仍可選擇以股權資金支應。
Arougheti表示，隨著資本支出規模擴大，融資來源已從主要依靠股權資金，轉向投資等級債務，如今部分需求開始流入槓桿融資與私募信貸市場，顯示AI建設的資金結構持續演變。
不過，長約與高信用租戶並不代表風險消失。穆迪本周稍早指出，AI與數位基礎設施正創造龐大、長期的融資需求，推動私募信貸市場超越傳統直接放款業務。
穆迪提醒，雖然許多借款人與交易對手具投資等級信用，但集中度、施工、資產殘值與循環融資風險也正在增加。這意味除了租戶能否付租，投資人仍須評估開發案能否順利完工、租期結束後資產價值，以及資金與交易關係是否過度集中。
paras_en: AI infrastructure investment fever continues, and large alternative asset managers on Wall Street are joining the expansion by owning data centers and signing long‑term leases. Amid market worries that heavily indebted new‑cloud providers could default and that massive AI spending may not yield sufficient returns, firms stress that their strategy focuses on physical assets, long‑term rental income, and credit‑worthy large‑tech tenants.

Reuters reported that Blue Owl (OWL‑US) co‑CEO Marc Lipschultz said the firm holds the physical infrastructure essential for the digital economy’s growth, typically leasing it on 15‑ to 20‑year contracts with rent escalations each year, creating predictable, growing income for investors. He emphasized the company’s focus on limiting short‑term leases and risks tied to AI token pricing.

Alternative‑asset managers rose in intraday trading on Thursday (the 29th): Blue Owl up 6.5%, Ares Management (ARES‑US) up 2%, KKR (KKR‑US) and Blackstone (BX‑US) each up 2.5%, and Apollo Global Management (APO‑US) up 3.7%.

Targeting large‑tech tenants and securing income with long‑term leases. Data centers house the servers and compute equipment needed to train and run AI models. As big tech firms race to expand compute capacity, demand for such facilities has surged, presenting a once‑in‑a‑generation investment opportunity for alternative‑asset managers.
Blue Owl said it currently operates or is building more than 130 data centers, with leased and owned capacity totaling nearly 14 GW, plus another 21 GW of potential development projects.

Blue Owl CFO Alan Kirshenbaum said the firm’s data‑center investments are not a direct bet on AI’s winners and losers, but rather an assumption of credit risk from tenants such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta (META‑US). He also noted the firm does not expect compute demand to decline.

Ares’ data‑center development strategy focuses on metropolitan areas such as Tokyo, Osaka, London and São Paulo, pre‑leasing projects to ultra‑large cloud providers with investment‑grade credit. Leases run 12‑ to 15‑years, contain no early‑termination rights for tenants, and include rent escalations tied to inflation.

Blackstone highlighted last week that its focus is on physical infrastructure and long‑term contract assets. The vast majority of its data centers have initial lease terms of 15‑ to 20‑years, 96% of counterparties have investment‑grade credit ratings, and the average market value of the assets is $2.5 trillion.
Blackstone President Jonathan Gray said on the earnings call that, given these terms, the firm does not view the related investment risk as especially high.

AI financing needs are expanding, and private‑credit funds are filling more of the funding gap. AI spending on data centers, power, equipment and software is seen as one of the largest investment waves ever, comparable to the rise of the internet and the railway expansion era.

Ares estimates that by 2030 AI‑related capital‑expenditure demand will exceed $5 trillion, with about $2 trillion earmarked for data‑center construction and associated power generation and transmission infrastructure.

Regarding the AI‑related asset sell‑off earlier this month, Ares CEO Michael Arougheti said investors are scrutinizing counterparty risk more closely and reassessing pricing. He downplayed the impact of rising borrowing costs on AI‑construction financing, noting firms can still turn to equity capital.

Arougheti added that as capital‑expenditure scales up, financing sources have shifted from primarily equity to investment‑grade debt, with some demand now flowing into leveraged finance and private‑credit markets, showing the evolving capital structure of AI projects.

However, long‑term leases with high‑credit tenants do not eliminate risk. Moody’s earlier this week warned that AI and digital infrastructure are generating massive, long‑term financing needs, pushing private‑credit markets beyond traditional direct‑lending business.

Moody’s cautioned that while many borrowers and counterparties have investment‑grade credit, concentration, construction, residual asset values and revolving‑finance risks are rising. This means investors must assess not only tenant rent‑payment ability but also project completion, post‑lease asset value, and whether funding and transaction relationships are overly concentrated.

items.title: 不只1兆美元！Alphabet再揭985億美元潛在負擔 AI風險有多大？
items.title_en: More Than $1 Trillion! Alphabet Unveils Additional $98.5 Billion Potential Liability – How Big Is the AI Risk?
paras: Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)最新申報文件揭露，其人工智慧(AI)投資風險不僅止於先前公布的逾1兆美元採購、租賃與其他支出義務，另有約985億美元或有承諾，可能在特定條件下轉為實際負擔。同時，Google Cloud第三季未履約合約金額的增幅，逾三分之一來自Alphabet參與成立的合資公司，引發市場對訂單來源與成長品質的檢視。
外媒報導，Alphabet周四(29日)提交季度申報文件，披露多項前一天財報電話會議未充分說明的AI相關曝險。除了財務長Anat Ashkenazi先前公布的逾1兆美元承諾，另列出的985億美元或有承諾，較前一季增加約230億美元。
這些安排包括擔保資料中心租金、支持合作夥伴採購電力設備，以及可能須向客戶買回AI晶片系統。相關金額並非全數已成為到期債務，但意味Alphabet除自身建設支出外，也承擔合作夥伴部分營運與融資風險。

雲端新增訂單逾三分之一來自關係企業

截至9月底，Google Cloud未履約合約金額由三個月前的5,139億美元，增至5,608億美元，單季增加469億美元。其中168億美元來自與Crux AI簽訂的多年協議，約占單季增幅的36%。
Crux AI是Alphabet與黑石集團(BX-US)共同成立的事業，在申報文件中被列為關係人。Alphabet持有少數股權，並承諾提供最高100億美元的資料中心與能源相關擔保支持。
未履約合約通常被投資人視為未來營收成長的重要指標，但這次揭露顯示，部分新增需求來自Alphabet本身協助成立、並提供支持的企業，而非完全獨立的外部客戶。
Synovus Trust資深投資組合經理Dan Morgan表示，這讓雲端訂單成長的吸引力打了折扣；若訂單來自大量外部客戶，會更令人安心。他認為，投資人必須進一步檢視，這類需求是否存在企業自行扶植、再轉化為自身訂單的循環。
Morgan也指出，未來市場須更仔細分析雲端供應商的訂單結構，例如甲骨文(ORCL-US)大量未履約合約，就來自其本身也是重要參與者的資料中心合作計畫Stargate。

能源擔保倍增 部分TPU系統附買回安排

申報文件顯示，Alphabet能源相關擔保增加逾一倍至162億美元，相當於替合作夥伴購買昂貴電力設備提供信用支持，以供應資料中心所需。相關條款期限延伸至2049年1月，相較6月文件所列的2026年9月，大幅拉長。
此外，Alphabet可能須買回最多66億美元已售出的AI晶片系統。部分客戶有權按預先約定的折扣價格，將Google張量處理器(TPU)系統售回。Alphabet則表示，目前客戶沒有誘因行使這項權利。
支撐AI擴張的搜尋業務也出現壓力。第三季Google搜尋付費點擊次數年增8%，低於第二季的13%，儘管執行長皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)表示，搜尋查詢量增速創五年來最快。
商務長Philipp Schindler先前在電話會議說明，AI Mode查詢量強勁成長，但變現能力較低，因此影響營收表現。公司正擴大AI Mode廣告投放，並首次拓展至國際市場。

投資資產與AI代理風險同步浮現

Alphabet帳上2,651億美元現金與有價證券中，752億美元為附有短期出售限制的SpaceX股票，占比約28%。這也意味，不能將這筆資產總額全數視為可立即動用的現金。
公司私人持股上季產生約30億美元帳面收益，較第二季的774億美元大幅縮減。《彭博》先前辨識，這類持股主要為Anthropic股權。
在技術風險方面，Alphabet首次揭露，自主AI代理在模型測試期間，曾採取「超出預定範圍」的行動。公司正準備向Gemini應用程式的10億名使用者推出代理功能，相關揭露也讓部署安全與管理能力受到關注。
Alphabet對上述申報內容不予置評。
paras_en: Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US) disclosed in its latest filing that its AI investment risk extends beyond the previously announced over‑$1 trillion commitments for purchases, leases and other expenses, adding an additional roughly $98.5 billion of contingent obligations that could become actual liabilities under certain conditions. At the same time, the increase in Google Cloud’s Q3 non‑performance contract amount – more than a third of which comes from a joint venture Alphabet helped create – has prompted market scrutiny of order sources and growth quality.

Foreign media reported that Alphabet filed its quarterly report on Thursday (the 29th), revealing several AI‑related exposures that were not fully explained in the earnings call the day before. In addition to CFO Anat Ashkenazi’s previously disclosed over‑$1 trillion commitment, the filing lists a $98.5 billion contingent commitment, up about $23 billion from the prior quarter.

These arrangements include guarantees for data‑center rent, support for partners’ procurement of power equipment, and possible buy‑backs of AI chip systems from customers. The amounts are not all due debt yet, but they mean Alphabet assumes part of its partners’ operating and financing risk in addition to its own construction spend.

Cloud new orders – more than one‑third – come from related entities. As of the end of September, Google Cloud’s non‑performance contract amount rose from $513.9 billion three months earlier to $560.8 billion, a quarterly increase of $46.9 billion. Of that, $16.8 billion is tied to a multi‑year agreement with Crux AI, roughly 36% of the quarterly rise.

Crux AI is a venture jointly founded by Alphabet and Blackstone (BX‑US) and is listed as a related party in the filing. Alphabet holds a minority stake and has pledged up to $10 billion of data‑center and energy‑related guarantee support.

Non‑performance contracts are usually viewed by investors as a key indicator of future revenue growth, but this disclosure shows that part of the new demand comes from companies Alphabet helped create and support, rather than wholly independent external customers.

Senior portfolio manager Dan Morgan of Synovus Trust said this dampens the appeal of cloud‑order growth; if orders came from a broad base of external customers, it would be more reassuring. He believes investors need to examine whether such demand reflects a cycle of companies being nurtured and then turned into Alphabet’s own orders.

Morgan also noted that the market will need to scrutinize cloud providers’ order structures more closely, citing Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) large non‑performance contracts that stem from its own data‑center partnership program Stargate.

Energy guarantees more than double; some TPU systems include buy‑back provisions. The filing shows Alphabet’s energy‑related guarantees more than doubled to $16.2 billion, effectively providing credit support for partners to purchase expensive power equipment needed for data‑centers. The related terms now run through January 2049, a significant extension from the September 2026 deadline listed in the June filing.

In addition, Alphabet may have to buy back up to $6.6 billion of AI chip systems it has already sold. Certain customers have the right, at a pre‑agreed discounted price, to sell Google Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) systems back to Alphabet, which says customers currently have no incentive to exercise that right.

The search business that underpins AI expansion is also under pressure. In Q3, paid Google Search clicks grew 8% year‑over‑year, down from 13% in Q2, even though CEO Sundar Pichai said search query growth was the fastest in five years.

Chief Business Officer Philipp Schindler previously explained in the earnings call that AI Mode query volume is growing strongly but monetization is lower, hurting revenue performance. The company is expanding AI Mode ad placements and is launching them internationally for the first time.

Investment assets and AI‑agent risk surface together. Of Alphabet’s $265.1 billion in cash and marketable securities, $75.2 billion is in SpaceX stock subject to short‑sale restrictions, about 28% of the total, meaning that amount cannot be treated as fully available cash.

The company’s private‑equity holdings generated about $3 billion of book income last quarter, a sharp decline from $77.4 billion in Q2. Bloomberg previously identified these holdings as primarily Anthropic equity.

On the technology‑risk side, Alphabet disclosed for the first time that its autonomous AI agents took actions “beyond the intended scope” during model testing. The firm is preparing to roll out the agent feature to the 1 billion users of its Gemini app, raising concerns about deployment safety and governance.
Alphabet declined to comment on the filing contents.

items.title: 疑涉中國情報活動！黃仁勳身邊人士遭美方監控 輝達：客戶往來正常
items.title_en: Possible Chinese Spy Activity! Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Associate Under U.S. Surveillance, Nvidia Says Customer Interactions Normal
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)周四(29日)回應《紐約時報》(NYT)報導，針對美國情報機構懷疑一名與執行長黃仁勳關係密切的人士，可能替中國情報單位工作，公司強調黃仁勳與客戶互動並不異常，客戶也無法取得輝達商業機密或相關國安資訊。
《紐約時報》引述知悉情報監控情況的人士報導，與新加坡雲端業者Megaspeed有關聯的Alice Huang，與黃仁勳建立密切關係，引起美方情報機構關注。報導稱，美方擔憂她可能協助中國政府取得輝達及黃仁勳掌握的資訊，也關切黃仁勳能接觸美國總統川普。這些屬報導引述的情報疑慮，並非已獲證實的間諜身分。

輝達稱客戶往來正常 轉運疑雲去年已查清

輝達發言人向《CNBC》表示，Megaspeed只是公司眾多區域雲端客戶之一，黃仁勳每年與數千名客戶交流，與該公司人士互動並不特殊，客戶不會因此接觸到商業機密或相關國安資訊。
報導另指出，Megaspeed先前曾被懷疑協助企業規避美國對輝達AI晶片的出口管制，將受限制產品轉運至中國。
輝達對此表示，針對這家區域雲端業者的轉運指控，去年已經過徹底調查並遭駁斥。公司未在這份回應中詳述調查過程。
針對Alice Huang，輝達則表示，相信若美國政府認為任何人對美國產業構成威脅，就會通知公司，暗示未曾收到相關通報。這項說法與晶片轉運調查是不同事項，不能據此認定情報疑慮也已獲釐清。

AI晶片牽動美中角力 黃仁勳積極接觸川普

輝達AI晶片既是開發AI的重要工具，也成為美中科技競爭與經貿談判的焦點。部分政治人物及分析師擔憂，這些晶片可能被用於中國軍事AI模型，或協助中國商用模型與美國技術競爭。
隨著AI在政策中的重要性提升，黃仁勳與川普互動增加，曾共同出席國宴、AI峰會及海外行程，並強調建設美國AI基礎設施，同時爭取部分輝達晶片獲准銷往中國。
美國政府今年稍早批准H200晶片對中出口，但中國監管機關阻止進口。H200屬於Hopper架構，並非目前美國AI開發商採用、速度更快的Blackwell世代產品。
輝達發言人主張，中國政府並非透過Megaspeed等區域雲端業者尋求輝達產品，而是阻擋美國AI晶片，以保護本土產業。公司去年曾就中國市場特規AI晶片認列約45億美元減損，凸顯出口限制與市場准入政策對其業務的衝擊。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) on Thursday (the 29th) responded to a New York Times (NYT) report that U.S. intelligence agencies suspect a person close to CEO Jensen Huang may be working for Chinese intelligence; the company stressed that Huang’s interactions with customers are normal and that customers cannot obtain Nvidia’s trade secrets or related national‑security information.

The NYT, citing sources familiar with the surveillance, reported that Alice Huang, who is linked to Singapore cloud provider Megaspeed and has a close relationship with Jensen Huang, has drawn U.S. intelligence attention. The report said U.S. officials worry she could help the Chinese government obtain information held by Nvidia and Huang, and they are also concerned about Huang’s access to former President Donald Trump. These are reported intelligence concerns, not confirmed spy identities.

Nvidia said customer interactions are normal and the cloud‑service speculation was cleared last year. A Nvidia spokesperson told CNBC that Megaspeed is just one of many regional cloud customers, that Huang talks to thousands of customers each year, and that his dealings with the company’s personnel are unremarkable; customers do not gain access to trade secrets or national‑security data.
The report also noted that Megaspeed had previously been suspected of helping companies evade U.S. export controls on Nvidia AI chips by rerouting restricted products to China.

Nvidia said the allegations that the regional cloud provider was involved in such rerouting were thoroughly investigated and refuted last year, though the company did not detail the investigation in its response.

Regarding Alice Huang, Nvidia said it believes that if the U.S. government deemed any individual a threat to American industry it would notify the company, implying it has not received such a notice. This statement concerns a different matter from the chip‑rerouting probe and does not resolve the intelligence concerns.

AI chips are a focal point of U.S.–China rivalry, and Jensen Huang has been actively engaging with Donald Trump. Nvidia’s AI chips are essential tools for AI development and have become a centerpiece of the tech and trade competition between the two countries.

As AI’s policy importance grows, Huang’s interactions with Trump have increased; they have jointly attended state banquets, AI summits and overseas trips, with Huang emphasizing the building of U.S. AI infrastructure while also seeking approval for some Nvidia chips to be sold to China.

Earlier this year the U.S. government approved export of the H200 chip to China, but Chinese regulators blocked its import. The H200, based on the Hopper architecture, is not the newer, faster Blackwell generation currently used by U.S. AI developers.

A Nvidia spokesperson argued that the Chinese government is not seeking Nvidia products through regional cloud providers like Megaspeed, but is instead blocking U.S. AI chips to protect its domestic industry. The company recorded about $4.5 billion of impairment last year for special‑spec AI chips in the Chinese market, highlighting the impact of export restrictions and market‑access policies on its business.

items.title: 不讓華爾街猜透！華許保留升息底牌 重塑Fed決策模式
items.title_en: Keeping Wall Street Guessing! Warsh Holds the Raising‑Rates Card, Reshapes Fed Decision‑Making Model
paras: 聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)正改變與市場溝通的方式。他周三在記者會上拒絕承諾固定政策路徑，同時暗示利率仍可能上升。分析指出，讓華爾街保持不確定性，可能成為他保留政策彈性、推動Fed改革的重要工具，但也引發決策透明度與延後緊縮風險的質疑。
華許上任初期，因川普曾將降息視為挑選Fed主席的重要條件，加上Fed在通膨明顯高於2%時，仍於6月與7月按兵不動，抗通膨決心一度受到挑戰。9月升息及其偏鷹派的經濟評估，才讓市場看法轉向。

拒絕承諾政策路徑 為12月升息保留空間

9月會議後，投資人一度認為Fed本周可能再升息，直到兩名高層官員出面降低市場預期。華許這次則明確否認政策已有既定方向，表示若對貨幣政策形成明確結論，就會當場宣布。
不過，他也釋出偏向升息的訊號，強調整體金融環境雖已收緊，卻仍不能稱為緊縮。這番話既保留選擇，也為通膨若持續頑固時，12月再度升息鋪路。
至於先前兩名官員是否奉命引導市場，華許拒絕證實。分析認為，市場確實接收到本次不升息的訊息，但華許未承認親自安排，使他能在避免直接承諾的同時，維持溝通彈性。
他也重申，Fed不會容忍通膨目標落在2%多的水準，目標就是2%。若經濟維持強勁，這項立場可能支持進一步升息；但12月會議前的新數據，也可能讓他主張生產力提高，容許經濟更快成長而不推升通膨。

減少利率表決次數 透明度與政策延誤受質疑

華許同時開始重塑Fed運作。他成立的專案小組，目標之一是改變通膨衡量方式；9月升息則有助回應外界對其抗通膨決心的質疑，為改革建立基礎。
他周三另宣布，未來兩年將減少預定利率表決次數。聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)仍每年開會八次，但2027年有一次會議、2028年有兩次會議不安排利率表決。
分析指出，這可能降低部分官員談話的市場影響力，因為發言與下次利率決策最多可能相隔約三個月；輪值投票的地區聯準銀行總裁，也會少掉部分原定表決機會。主席則仍可視需要隨時召開臨時會議。
然而，減少政策指引與表決機會，也引發透明度疑慮。PGIM美國首席經濟學家Robert Sockin認為，華許未充分解釋，為何在通膨偏高、金融環境尚未達緊縮程度下，本周仍選擇不升息。
Sockin直言，按兵不動是「政策錯誤」，過於漸進的Fed可能最終被迫將利率升得更高，增加衰退風險。華許的做法雖為改革與決策保留空間，但等待緊縮的代價，也可能直到難以及時補救時才浮現。
paras_en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is changing how he communicates with the market. At Wednesday's press conference he refused to commit to a fixed policy path while hinting that rates could still rise. Analysts say keeping Wall Street in uncertainty may be a tool for preserving policy flexibility and pushing Fed reforms, but it also raises questions about decision‑making transparency and the risk of delayed tightening.

Warsh’s early tenure was marked by Trump’s view that rate cuts were a key factor in selecting the Fed chair, and the Fed’s decision to stand pat in June and July even as inflation was clearly above 2%, challenging its anti‑inflation resolve. It was only after the September hike and his hawkish economic assessment that market sentiment shifted.

After the September meeting investors briefly thought the Fed might raise rates again this week, until two senior officials stepped in to temper expectations. This time Warsh explicitly denied that policy had a predetermined direction, saying that if a clear conclusion on monetary policy were reached it would be announced on the spot.

Nevertheless, he signaled a bias toward another hike, emphasizing that while the overall financial environment has tightened, it cannot yet be called restrictive. The comment leaves options open and paves the way for a possible December rate increase if inflation remains stubborn.

When asked whether the two officials were instructed to guide the market, Warsh declined to confirm. Analysts note the market did pick up the no‑hike signal, but Warsh’s refusal to acknowledge personal orchestration lets him maintain communication flexibility while avoiding a direct commitment.

He also reiterated that the Fed will not tolerate inflation running above its 2% target – the goal is exactly 2%. If the economy stays strong, this stance could support further hikes; however, new data before the December meeting could allow him to argue that productivity gains permit faster growth without pushing inflation higher.

Warsh is also reshaping Fed operations. A task force he created aims, among other things, to change how inflation is measured; the September hike helped address external doubts about the Fed’s anti‑inflation resolve and laid groundwork for reforms.

On Wednesday he announced that over the next two years the Fed will cut the number of scheduled rate‑vote meetings. The Federal Open Market Committee will still meet eight times a year, but in 2027 one meeting and in 2028 two meetings will not include a rate vote.

Analysts say this could reduce the market impact of some officials’ remarks, since comments may be spaced up to about three months from the next rate decision; rotating‑vote regional Fed presidents will also lose some of their scheduled voting opportunities. The chair, however, can still call emergency meetings as needed.

However, cutting policy guidance and voting opportunities also raises transparency concerns. PGIM U.S. chief economist Robert Sockin argues Warsh has not adequately explained why, with inflation still elevated and the financial environment not yet restrictive, the Fed chose to hold rates steady this week.

Sockin bluntly calls the hold a “policy mistake,” warning that an overly gradual Fed may eventually be forced to raise rates higher, increasing recession risk. Warsh’s approach may preserve reform space and decision‑making leeway, but the cost of delayed tightening could only become apparent when it is too late to remediate.

items.title: 一點風吹草動就可能再跌！美銀年底前避免重押 緊盯AI舉債風險
items.title_en: Even a Slight Breeze Could Trigger Another Drop! Bank of America Avoids Heavy Bets Before Year‑End, Watching AI Debt Risks Closely
paras: 熱門交易接連遭遇劇烈震盪，美國銀行(BAC-US)宏觀交易團隊正降低年底前的風險曝險，避免大舉押注。該行全球固定收益、外匯與大宗商品(FICC)宏觀交易共同主管Carlos Fernandez-Aller警告，市場相當脆弱，任何小意外都可能引發新一波部位平倉。
《彭博》周四(29日)報導，Fernandez-Aller在紐約辦公室接受訪問時表示，今年歐洲利率大幅波動，令宏觀基金尤其難以操作。新興市場投資人整體表現雖較好，但巴西總統魯拉意外勝選後引發的拋售，也讓市場見識到漲勢逆轉的速度。
他表示：「市場非常脆弱，任何小差錯，都可能讓先前看到的平倉潮延續。」因此，團隊目前承擔的風險相對有限。
近幾周，法國激烈政治抗議推升公債風險，一項衡量法債風險的指標升至歐債危機以來最高；魯拉連任則引發巴西貨幣周一創下逾20年來最大跌幅，凸顯政治事件對市場的衝擊。
利率市場同時受到多股力量拉扯，包括油價突破每桶110美元、經濟成長優於預期，以及各國政府債務不斷膨脹的疑慮。本月稍早，美國指標公債殖利率一度升至2002年以來最高。
美銀旗下FICC交易業務分為宏觀與微觀產品，第三季營收年減17%，主要受到房貸、市政債券與信用產品交易業務下滑拖累。
展望年底，Fernandez-Aller尤其關注信用利差。投資人愈來愈擔憂人工智慧(AI)交易前景，以及科技企業為支應投資而承擔的龐大債務，信用市場已出現避險訊號。
他表示，信用利差是自己密切追蹤的指標，可能成為市場「最後一隻落下的靴子」，意味若信用市場進一步惡化，可能引發下一波震盪。
不過，固定收益市場也出現一些變化，可能意味長天期政府公債殖利率逐漸接近上限。近期股市下跌或歐洲政治疑慮升高時，美國公債開始上漲，重新展現避險功能。
Fernandez-Aller將這項變化歸因於聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)強化抗通膨承諾。他認為，市場可能重新進入「壞消息就是好消息」的舊有模式，也就是疲弱經濟數據反而帶動市場上漲，而這是他近幾年少見的現象。
paras_en: Popular trades have been hit by sharp volatility, and Bank of America (BAC‑US) macro trading team is scaling back risk exposure before year‑end to avoid large bets. Carlos Fernandez‑Aller, co‑head of the bank’s global Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities (FICC) macro trading, warned that markets are very fragile and any small mishap could spark a new wave of position liquidations.

Bloomberg reported on Thursday (the 29th) that Fernandez‑Aller said in an interview from the New York office that this year’s European rate swings have made macro funds especially hard to manage. Emerging‑market investors have performed relatively well overall, but the sell‑off triggered by Brazil’s President Lula’s surprise re‑election showed how quickly a rally can reverse.
He said, “The market is extremely fragile; any small error could prolong the liquidation wave we’ve already seen.” As a result, the team’s current risk exposure is relatively limited.

In recent weeks, intense political protests in France have pushed sovereign‑bond risk higher, with a French‑bond risk gauge hitting its highest level since the Euro‑zone debt crisis; Lula’s re‑election also caused the Brazilian real on Monday to record its biggest drop in over 20 years, highlighting the impact of political events on markets.

The rates market is being pulled in multiple directions, including oil prices breaking above $110 per barrel, stronger‑than‑expected economic growth, and concerns over ever‑expanding sovereign debt. Earlier this month, U.S. benchmark Treasury yields briefly rose to their highest level since 2002.

Bank of America’s FICC trading business is split between macro and micro products, and third‑quarter revenue fell 17% year‑over‑year, mainly due to weakness in mortgage, municipal bond and credit product trading.

Looking toward year‑end, Fernandez‑Aller is especially focused on credit spreads. Investors are increasingly worried about the outlook for AI‑driven trading and the massive debt tech companies are taking on to fund investments, sending a hedging signal through the credit market.

He said credit spreads are a metric he watches closely and could be the market’s “last falling boot,” meaning that if the credit market deteriorates further it could trigger the next wave of turbulence.

However, the fixed‑income market is showing some shifts that may signal long‑dated government bond yields are edging toward a ceiling. When equities have fallen recently or European political worries have risen, U.S. Treasuries have started to climb, re‑asserting their safe‑haven role.

Fernandez‑Aller attributes this shift to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s reinforced anti‑inflation commitment. He believes the market may revert to the old “bad news is good news” pattern, where weak economic data actually lifts markets—a phenomenon he has rarely seen in recent years.

items.title: 不只股價跌慘！Google違約保險也變貴 AI投資回報再受質疑
items.title_en: Not Just a Stock Crash! Google’s Credit Default Insurance Also Gets More Expensive, AI Investment Returns Again Questioned
paras: Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)財報不如預期，不僅引發股價重挫，也推升債務違約保險成本。投資人愈來愈擔憂，公司透過舉債支持的龐大人工智慧(AI)投資，能否帶來足夠回報，相關壓力也波及其他科技企業。
《彭博》引述ICE Data Services數據報導，Google債務的5年期信用違約交換(CDS)利差，周四(29日)一度上升5.3個基點至84個基點，創9月21日以來最大升幅。臉書母公司Meta(META-US)與晶片大廠博通(AVGO-US)的CDS成本也同步走高。
CDS是投資人用來對沖債務違約損失的工具，成本上升通常反映市場要求更高的信用風險補償，但不等同企業即將違約。
Alphabet第三季營收低於市場預期，其中廣告營收成長速度降至一年多來最低。廣告業務是支應公司大規模AI投資的重要資金來源，因此成長放緩，也讓債券投資人更加關注資本支出與現金流之間的落差。
標普全球市場財智固定收益定價執行董事Gavan Nolan表示，若AI投資成功，股票投資人可能獲得豐厚報酬；但若投資失利，債權人也必須承擔損失風險。因此，債券投資人正緊盯資本支出，以及AI業務何時能產生正向自由現金流。
Nolan指出，就科技產業而言，信用市場在某種程度上，正傳遞與股票市場不同的訊息。
科技企業CDS交易也明顯升溫。巴克萊信用策略師Jigar Patel分析交易資料庫後指出，截至上周，與10家最大超大規模雲端業者及晶片製造商相關的CDS，今年交易量已增至去年的逾8倍，達1,760億美元。部分企業的CDS，例如SpaceX，直到最近幾個月才開始交易。
其中，甲骨文(ORCL-US)的CDS交易最活躍，2026年交易量已增至去年的近6倍，達468億美元。隨著AI建設日益仰賴外部融資，信用市場正成為投資人衡量科技業支出風險的重要觀察窗口。
paras_en: Alphabet, Google’s parent company (GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US), reported earnings that fell short of expectations, triggering a sharp drop in its share price and pushing up the cost of debt‑default insurance. Investors are increasingly worried whether the massive AI investments funded by borrowing will generate sufficient returns, and the pressure is spilling over to other tech firms.

Bloomberg, citing ICE Data Services, reported that the five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spread on Google’s debt rose by 5.3 basis points on Thursday (the 29th) to 84 basis points, the biggest increase since September 21. The CDS costs for Meta (META‑US), Facebook’s parent, and chip giant Broadcom (AVGO‑US) also climbed in tandem.

CDS contracts are tools investors use to hedge against debt‑default losses; a higher cost usually reflects the market demanding greater compensation for credit risk, but it does not mean the company is about to default.

Alphabet’s third‑quarter revenue missed market forecasts, with advertising revenue growth slowing to its lowest pace in more than a year. Advertising is a key source of funding for the company’s large‑scale AI investments, so the slowdown has heightened bond investors’ focus on the gap between capital spending and cash flow.

Gavan Nolan, Managing Director of Fixed‑Income Pricing at S&P Global Market Intelligence, said that if AI investments succeed, equity investors could reap generous rewards; but if they fail, creditors also face loss risk. Consequently, bond investors are closely watching capital expenditures and when AI operations might generate positive free cash flow.
Nolan noted that, for the technology sector, the credit market is, to some extent, conveying a message that differs from that of the equity market.

Barclays credit strategist Jigar Patel, after analyzing trading data, said that as of last week, CDS trading linked to the ten largest hyperscale cloud providers and chip makers has surged to more than eight times last year’s volume, reaching $176 billion. Some companies’ CDS contracts, such as SpaceX, only began trading in recent months.

Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) CDS activity was the most vigorous, with 2026‑dated contracts rising to nearly six times last year’s level, amounting to $46.8 billion. As AI infrastructure increasingly relies on external financing, the credit market is becoming a key window for investors to gauge spending risk in the tech industry.

items.title: 億萬富豪艾克曼只押少數股票！揭選股法則：鎖定20年後仍值錢的企業
items.title_en: Billionaire Ackman Bets on Only a Few Stocks! His Stock‑Picking Rule: Target Companies Still Valuable 20 Years From Now
paras: 億萬富豪避險基金經理人艾克曼(Bill Ackman)主張，持有一家優秀企業有一項簡單的判斷法則：放眼未來20年價值。
這位潘興廣場(Pershing Square)創辦人暨執行長在周三(28日)發布的一場Podcast訪談中，向挪威銀行投資管理公司(Norges Bank Investment Management)執行長Nicolai Tangen說：「一家偉大的企業，是你今天就可以買進，即使市場關閉20年，你仍能非常確信，10年或20年後，你持有的資產將具有極高價值。」
艾克曼表示，這類企業並不限於特定產業。他說：「我們喜歡那些看起來像收取權利金的公司，例如年金業務。你可以非常確信，這類年金收入在很長一段時間裡將以很快的速度成長，而且企業創造的現金不需要再投入自身業務。」
艾克曼旗下基金的投資組合集中在少數幾家公司上，例如大型科技股亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)及Meta(META-US)，也持有加拿大投資公司Brookfield(BN-US)、叫車服務業者優步(UBER-US)，以及支付卡服務業者威士卡(Visa)(V-US)和萬事達卡(Mastercard)(MA-US)。
艾克曼曾在2022年買進網飛(Netflix)(NFLX-US)短短幾個月就大舉賣出，認賠約4億美元，不過他在今年8月透露，旗下基金已重新投資這家串流媒體巨頭。Netflix股價10月下跌10%，原因包括營收展望令人失望、投資人對其內容策略的疑慮，以及競爭加劇。

好公司不等於好投資 買進價格同樣重要

艾克曼解釋，雖然全球可能有200至300家真正優秀的企業，但這些公司不一定經常以「足以構成一筆優質投資」的價格供投資人買進。
他表示，多數投資人追求的是「快速致富策略」，而資產管理產業本質上也偏向短期思維。真正需要的，是像傳奇投資人巴菲特(Warren Buffett)那樣，對企業採取更長期的眼光。
至於如何找出值得投資的股票，艾克曼提出以下建議：「找出你持有的某家公司最有說服力的放空者，聽聽他們的論點。如果你能逐一反駁所有論點，對自己的投資就能更有信心。」
他補充說：「找出最能說明你為什麼可能犯錯的人。接著要嘛讓他們說服你，證明你確實錯了，要嘛你就能仔細反駁他們提出的各項論點」，進而判斷哪一方的觀點更有道理。
艾克曼表示，旗下公司的檢核清單有助於篩選出最優秀的企業。其中一項條件，是能夠對企業目前的價值，以及企業在整個存續期間可創造的現金流抱持信心，而這些現金流將形成企業的競爭護城河。
他說：「如果你無法建立一套模型，合理推估一家企業未來10年、15年或20年的情況，我認為你就無法為它估值。有許多企業，我們根本不知道它們值多少錢，因此甚至不會考慮研究。」
他表示，投資人過度關注季度財報等短期因素。
艾克曼說：「我認為企業品質能否長期維持，是至關重要的。我們希望投資的公司，不會受到我們無法控制、稱為外部因素所影響。因此，我們不太投資對大宗商品、利率或監管變化高度敏感的企業。我們讓事情保持簡單。」

AI投資怎麼選？艾克曼：企業不是受惠就是面臨顛覆

談到人工智慧(AI)投資，艾克曼表示，所有企業不是與AI相關，就是面臨被AI顛覆的風險，這是投資人必須做出的判斷，「我們在川普宣布『解放日』關稅後買進亞馬遜，在Meta承諾投入大筆資本支出、令市場失望後買進該公司，微軟也是如此。」
艾克曼旗下在美國公開交易的封閉式基金潘興廣場(Pershing Square)(PSUS-US)，今年春季首次公開發行(IPO)，最近三個月上漲42%，但10月下跌16%。
由於科技股10月表現疲弱，加上市場擔憂AI支出，艾克曼部分大型持股受影響，例如Meta即使公布優於預期的財報，10月股價仍下跌14%。不過他持有的微軟因營收、獲利和自由現金流都優於預期，周三盤後股價勁揚2.9%。
paras_en: Billionaire hedge‑fund manager Bill Ackman says there’s a simple rule for holding a great company: look at its value over the next 20 years.

In a podcast interview on Wednesday the Pershing Square founder and CEO told Norges Bank Investment Management chief Nicolai Tangen, “A great business is one you can buy today and, even if the market were closed for 20 years, you’d be confident that in 10 or 20 years your holding will be worth a lot.”

Ackman says such companies aren’t limited to any particular sector. “We like businesses that look like they’re collecting premiums, such as annuity operations. You can be very sure that annuity cash flows will grow quickly for a long time, and the cash the company generates doesn’t need to be reinvested back into the business.”

Ackman’s fund portfolio is concentrated in a handful of names, including large‑cap tech stocks Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Meta (META‑US), as well as Canadian investment firm Brookfield (BN‑US), ride‑hailing company Uber (UBER‑US), and payment‑card issuers Visa (V‑US) and Mastercard (MA‑US).

Ackman bought Netflix (NFLX‑US) in 2022 and sold it a few months later, taking a loss of about $400 million, but he disclosed in August that his fund has re‑entered the streaming giant. Netflix shares fell 10% in October amid disappointing revenue outlook, investor doubts about its content strategy and heightened competition.

A good company is not automatically a good investment – the purchase price matters too. Ackman explains that while there may be 200‑300 truly great companies worldwide, they are not always available at prices that constitute a quality investment.

He says most investors chase “quick‑rich” strategies and the asset‑management industry is inherently short‑term‑focused. What’s needed is a longer‑term view like that of legendary investor Warren Buffett.

To find investable stocks, Ackman advises: “Identify the most persuasive short‑seller of a company you own and listen to their arguments. If you can refute each point, you’ll have more confidence in your investment.”

He adds: “Find the person who can best explain why you might be wrong. Either let them convince you you are indeed wrong, or carefully rebut every point they raise,” and then judge which side makes more sense.

Ackman says his firm’s checklist helps filter the very best companies. One criterion is confidence in the firm’s current value and the cash flows it can generate over its entire life, which become the company’s competitive moat.

He notes, “If you can’t build a model that reasonably projects a company’s situation 10, 15 or 20 years out, you can’t value it. There are many firms whose worth we simply don’t know, so we don’t even consider researching them.”
He says investors focus too much on quarterly earnings and other short‑term factors.

Ackman says, “I think the durability of a company’s quality over the long term is crucial. We want companies that aren’t affected by external factors we can’t control. So we avoid firms highly sensitive to commodities, interest rates or regulatory changes. We keep things simple.”

On AI investing, Ackman says every company is either benefiting from AI or facing disruption from it, and investors must decide which. “We bought Amazon after Trump announced the ‘tariff‑free’ day, we bought Meta after it pledged big capex and the market was disappointed, and the same with Microsoft.”
Ackman’s publicly traded closed‑end fund Pershing Square (PSUS‑US) went public in the spring, has risen 42% over the past three months but fell 16% in October.

Because tech stocks were weak in October and markets worried about AI spending, some of Ackman’s large positions were hit – Meta fell 14% in October despite an earnings beat, while Microsoft, which beat revenue, profit and free‑cash‑flow expectations, jumped 2.9% after hours on Wednesday.

items.title: 升息壓得住AI熱潮？Fed傳聲筒揭華許政策兩難
items.title_en: Will Rising Rates Dampen the AI Boom? Fed Whisperer Highlights Policy Dilemma
paras: 人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮是否不怕高利率，正成為聯準會(Fed)判斷後續升息幅度的關鍵。有「Fed傳聲筒」之稱的《華爾街日報》記者Nick Timiraos撰文指出，主席華許(Kevin Warsh)對美國經濟提出兩項觀察：高利率已開始影響AI投資，而經濟成長動能也正擴散至AI以外領域。這兩股力量可能把利率決策推向不同方向。
Fed周三如預期維持利率不變，市場普遍預期12月將再度升息。不過，比下一次何時行動更棘手的問題，是利率究竟還須升多高，才能讓通膨回到2%目標，同時避免過度打擊經濟。

AI並非利率免疫體 舉債擴張放大緊縮影響

過去幾個月，市場常見的看法是，AI投資撐起美國經濟，而科技巨頭資金充裕、預期回報龐大，因此不會因利率小幅上升就放慢腳步。華許對此提出質疑，強調利率會透過直接或間接管道，影響幾乎所有經濟活動。
他指出，自Fed上月升息後，已有跡象顯示投資人變得更挑剔，部分高風險企業借款成本明顯攀升。隨著科技業愈來愈依賴債券與股票市場籌資，過去由自有現金支應的擴張，也開始更直接受到金融環境影響。
巴克萊美國首席經濟學家Marc Giannoni表示，認為所有AI相關投資都對利率毫無反應，是過於極端的看法。大型科技公司或許不必借錢，但資料中心營運商及周邊建設業者往往需要融資，債務利率對它們相當重要。
如果AI投資比市場想像中更容易受到高利率影響，Fed可能只需較少次升息，就能抑制需求，也能減輕對其他產業的衝擊。反之，若AI熱潮對借款成本上升無動於衷，緊縮壓力就可能更集中在房市、商用不動產、小企業及中低收入家庭。
瑞銀美國首席經濟學家Jonathan Pingle形容，Fed幾乎需要「兩套利率」：一套對付AI熱潮及其帶來的股市財富效應，另一套適用於其他經濟活動。

壓力可能突然爆發 成長擴散又添通膨變數

問題在於，AI投資整體看來可能仍然強勁，脆弱環節卻已逐步累積壓力。隨著更多建設仰賴舉債，高利率會先衝擊財務較弱的借款人，最後才影響現金充裕的大型企業。
BNY Investments首席經濟學家、前Fed資深顧問Vincent Reinhart警告，每次升息可能看似影響有限，直到金融環境突然承受不住，支出下滑幅度甚至超過Fed模型預測。
華許的另一項觀察，卻可能指向不同的政策需求。他認為，美國經濟強勁不能全歸功於AI，企業投資不僅有力，也正在擴散。若更多產業與消費者增加支出，短期內可能推升價格，尤其海外衝突持續支撐能源與原物料成本之際。
不過，華許也強調，強勁成長未必一定引發通膨。Reinhart將他的立場解讀為：Fed仍須進一步行動，但所需幅度可能不大。
這番說法未能完全說服債市。華許發言期間，投資人降低對明年升息的押注，長天期美債殖利率卻小幅上升，反映對長期通膨的疑慮。道明證券策略師認為，華許未清楚解釋為何要等到12月才升息；美銀美國利率策略主管Mark Cabana也批評，相關回答不夠清楚、有說服力。
Reinhart則認為，短期風險仍偏向Fed最終必須採取比預期更強的緊縮措施。若能源與原物料價格停留在較高水準，其他價格可能陸續跟進，使通膨更難消退，迫使Fed在2027年加大緊縮力道。
paras_en: Is the AI investment frenzy immune to higher rates? That question is becoming a key factor in the Fed’s decision on how much to raise rates further. In an article by Nick Timiraos, a reporter dubbed the Fed’s “whisperer,” the Fed Chair Kevin Warsh offered two observations about the U.S. economy: higher rates have begun to affect AI investment, and the momentum of economic growth is spreading beyond AI. These two forces could push rate policy in opposite directions.

The Fed left rates unchanged on Wednesday as expected, and markets broadly anticipate another hike in December. But the more difficult question than when to act next is how high rates must rise to bring inflation back to the 2% target while avoiding an excessive blow to the economy.

AI is not rate‑immune; borrowing expansion magnifies the impact of tightening. In recent months, the prevailing view has been that AI investment supports the U.S. economy, and that tech giants have ample cash and huge expected returns, so they will not slow down for modest rate hikes. Warsh challenges this, stressing that rates affect almost all economic activity directly or indirectly.

He noted that since the Fed’s rate hike last month, there are signs investors have become more selective, and the borrowing costs for some high‑risk firms have risen sharply. As the tech sector increasingly relies on bonds and equity markets for financing, the expansion that was once funded by cash reserves is now more directly affected by the financial environment.

Barkley’s U.S. chief economist Marc Giannoni said it is too extreme to think all AI‑related investment is rate‑neutral. Large tech firms may not need to borrow, but data‑center operators and related construction firms often require financing, and debt rates matter a great deal to them.

If AI investment is more sensitive to high rates than the market imagines, the Fed may need fewer hikes to curb demand and could lessen the impact on other sectors. Conversely, if the AI boom is indifferent to borrowing costs, tightening pressure could concentrate on housing, commercial real estate, small businesses, and lower‑income households.

Swiss Re’s U.S. chief economist Jonathan Pingle described the Fed as needing “two rates”: one to tackle the AI boom and its wealth effect on the stock market, and another for other economic activities.

The pressure could erupt suddenly; growth diffusion adds another inflation variable. The problem is that AI investment overall may still be strong, but vulnerable points are gradually accumulating pressure. As more construction relies on borrowing, higher rates will first hit financially weaker borrowers before affecting cash‑rich large firms.

BNY Investments chief economist and former Fed senior adviser Vincent Reinhart warned that each rate hike might appear to have limited impact until the financial environment suddenly can’t bear it, and spending cuts could exceed Fed model forecasts.

Warsh’s other observation may point to different policy needs. He believes the U.S. economy’s strength cannot be attributed solely to AI; corporate investment is robust and spreading. If more industries and consumers increase spending, prices could rise in the short term, especially as overseas conflicts continue to support energy and commodity costs.
However, Warsh also stressed that strong growth does not necessarily trigger inflation. Reinhart interpreted his stance as the Fed still needing to act, but the required magnitude may be small.

These remarks did not fully convince the bond market. During Warsh’s comments, investors reduced bets on next year’s hike, yet long‑term Treasury yields rose slightly, reflecting concerns about long‑term inflation. TD Securities strategists said Warsh failed to explain why a December hike was necessary; Bank of America’s U.S. rate strategy head Mark Cabana also criticized the answers as unclear and unconvincing.

Reinhart believes short‑term risks still lean toward the Fed ultimately needing to adopt stronger tightening than expected. If energy and commodity prices remain high, other prices may follow, making inflation harder to quell and forcing the Fed to increase tightening in 2027.

items.title: 不押誰的AI最強！華爾街搶當房東 靠科技巨頭長約收租
items.title_en: Who Has the Strongest AI? Wall Street Rushes to Become Landlords, Relying on Tech Giants for Long-Term Rent
paras: AI基礎建設投資熱潮持續，華爾街大型另類資產管理公司正透過持有資料中心、簽訂長期租約，參與這波擴張。面對市場擔憂高負債的新型雲端業者可能違約，以及龐大AI支出未必帶來足夠回報，業者強調，其策略重點在於實體資產、長期租金收入，以及信用良好的大型科技租戶。
《路透》報導，Blue Owl(OWL-US)共同執行長Marc Lipschultz表示，公司持有數位經濟成長不可或缺的實體基礎設施，通常以15至20年租約出租，並約定租金逐年調升，為投資人創造可預測且持續成長的收入。他強調，公司著重限制短期租約與AI詞元(token)定價等相關風險。
另類資產管理業者周四(29日)盤中股價走高，Blue Owl上漲6.5%，Ares Management(ARES-US)上漲2%，KKR(KKR-US)與黑石集團(BX-US)各漲2.5%，阿波羅全球管理(APO-US)則上漲3.7%。

鎖定大型科技租戶 以長約確保收入

資料中心容納訓練與運行AI模型所需的伺服器及運算設備。隨著大型科技公司競相擴充算力，相關設施需求大增，被另類資產管理業者視為一個世代難得一見的投資機會。
Blue Owl表示，目前營運中或興建中的資料中心超過130座，已承租與自有容量合計近14吉瓦(GW)，另有21吉瓦的潛在開發項目。
Blue Owl財務長Alan Kirshenbaum表示，公司投資資料中心，並不是直接押注AI產業的勝負，而是承擔微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與Meta(META-US)等租戶的信用風險。他也表示，公司不預期運算需求會下降。
Ares的資料中心開發策略則聚焦東京、大阪、倫敦與聖保羅等都會區，事先將開發案出租給具投資等級信用的超大規模雲端業者。租約期限為12至15年，不賦予租戶提前終止權，並設有隨通膨調升租金的條款。
黑石上周也強調，其布局重點為實體基礎設施與長期合約資產。旗下絕大多數資料中心的初始租期為15至20年，96%的交易對手具投資等級信用評等，平均市值達2.5兆美元。
黑石總裁Jonathan Gray在財報電話會議上表示，從這些條件來看，公司並不認為相關投資風險特別高。

AI融資需求擴大 私募信貸承接更多資金缺口

涵蓋資料中心、電力、設備與軟體的AI支出，被視為歷來規模最大的投資浪潮之一，可與網際網路興起及鐵路擴張時期相比。
Ares估計，截至2030年，AI相關資本支出需求將略超過5兆美元，其中約2兆美元用於資料中心建築，以及周邊發電與輸電基礎設施。
針對本月稍早的AI相關資產拋售，Ares執行長Michael Arougheti表示，投資人正更仔細區分交易對手風險，並重新評估應如何定價。他也淡化借款成本上升對AI建設融資的影響，指出業者仍可選擇以股權資金支應。
Arougheti表示，隨著資本支出規模擴大，融資來源已從主要依靠股權資金，轉向投資等級債務，如今部分需求開始流入槓桿融資與私募信貸市場，顯示AI建設的資金結構持續演變。
不過，長約與高信用租戶並不代表風險消失。穆迪本周稍早指出，AI與數位基礎設施正創造龐大、長期的融資需求，推動私募信貸市場超越傳統直接放款業務。
穆迪提醒，雖然許多借款人與交易對手具投資等級信用，但集中度、施工、資產殘值與循環融資風險也正在增加。這意味除了租戶能否付租，投資人仍須評估開發案能否順利完工、租期結束後資產價值，以及資金與交易關係是否過度集中。
paras_en: AI infrastructure investment fever continues, and large alternative asset managers on Wall Street are joining the expansion by owning data centers and signing long‑term leases. Amid market worries that heavily indebted new‑cloud providers could default and that massive AI spending may not yield sufficient returns, firms stress that their strategy focuses on physical assets, long‑term rental income, and credit‑worthy large‑tech tenants.

Reuters reported that Blue Owl (OWL‑US) co‑CEO Marc Lipschultz said the firm holds the physical infrastructure essential for the digital economy’s growth, typically leasing it on 15‑ to 20‑year contracts with rent escalations each year, creating predictable, growing income for investors. He emphasized the company’s focus on limiting short‑term leases and risks tied to AI token pricing.

Alternative‑asset managers rose in intraday trading on Thursday (the 29th): Blue Owl up 6.5%, Ares Management (ARES‑US) up 2%, KKR (KKR‑US) and Blackstone (BX‑US) each up 2.5%, and Apollo Global Management (APO‑US) up 3.7%.

Targeting large‑tech tenants and securing income with long‑term leases. Data centers house the servers and compute equipment needed to train and run AI models. As big tech firms race to expand compute capacity, demand for such facilities has surged, presenting a once‑in‑a‑generation investment opportunity for alternative‑asset managers.
Blue Owl said it currently operates or is building more than 130 data centers, with leased and owned capacity totaling nearly 14 GW, plus another 21 GW of potential development projects.

Blue Owl CFO Alan Kirshenbaum said the firm’s data‑center investments are not a direct bet on AI’s winners and losers, but rather an assumption of credit risk from tenants such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta (META‑US). He also noted the firm does not expect compute demand to decline.

Ares’ data‑center development strategy focuses on metropolitan areas such as Tokyo, Osaka, London and São Paulo, pre‑leasing projects to ultra‑large cloud providers with investment‑grade credit. Leases run 12‑ to 15‑years, contain no early‑termination rights for tenants, and include rent escalations tied to inflation.

Blackstone highlighted last week that its focus is on physical infrastructure and long‑term contract assets. The vast majority of its data centers have initial lease terms of 15‑ to 20‑years, 96% of counterparties have investment‑grade credit ratings, and the average market value of the assets is $2.5 trillion.
Blackstone President Jonathan Gray said on the earnings call that, given these terms, the firm does not view the related investment risk as especially high.

AI financing needs are expanding, and private‑credit funds are filling more of the funding gap. AI spending on data centers, power, equipment and software is seen as one of the largest investment waves ever, comparable to the rise of the internet and the railway expansion era.

Ares estimates that by 2030 AI‑related capital‑expenditure demand will exceed $5 trillion, with about $2 trillion earmarked for data‑center construction and associated power generation and transmission infrastructure.

Regarding the AI‑related asset sell‑off earlier this month, Ares CEO Michael Arougheti said investors are scrutinizing counterparty risk more closely and reassessing pricing. He downplayed the impact of rising borrowing costs on AI‑construction financing, noting firms can still turn to equity capital.

Arougheti added that as capital‑expenditure scales up, financing sources have shifted from primarily equity to investment‑grade debt, with some demand now flowing into leveraged finance and private‑credit markets, showing the evolving capital structure of AI projects.

However, long‑term leases with high‑credit tenants do not eliminate risk. Moody’s earlier this week warned that AI and digital infrastructure are generating massive, long‑term financing needs, pushing private‑credit markets beyond traditional direct‑lending business.

Moody’s cautioned that while many borrowers and counterparties have investment‑grade credit, concentration, construction, residual asset values and revolving‑finance risks are rising. This means investors must assess not only tenant rent‑payment ability but also project completion, post‑lease asset value, and whether funding and transaction relationships are overly concentrated.

items.title: 不只1兆美元！Alphabet再揭985億美元潛在負擔 AI風險有多大？
items.title_en: More Than $1 Trillion! Alphabet Unveils Additional $98.5 Billion Potential Liability – How Big Is the AI Risk?
paras: Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)最新申報文件揭露，其人工智慧(AI)投資風險不僅止於先前公布的逾1兆美元採購、租賃與其他支出義務，另有約985億美元或有承諾，可能在特定條件下轉為實際負擔。同時，Google Cloud第三季未履約合約金額的增幅，逾三分之一來自Alphabet參與成立的合資公司，引發市場對訂單來源與成長品質的檢視。
外媒報導，Alphabet周四(29日)提交季度申報文件，披露多項前一天財報電話會議未充分說明的AI相關曝險。除了財務長Anat Ashkenazi先前公布的逾1兆美元承諾，另列出的985億美元或有承諾，較前一季增加約230億美元。
這些安排包括擔保資料中心租金、支持合作夥伴採購電力設備，以及可能須向客戶買回AI晶片系統。相關金額並非全數已成為到期債務，但意味Alphabet除自身建設支出外，也承擔合作夥伴部分營運與融資風險。

雲端新增訂單逾三分之一來自關係企業

截至9月底，Google Cloud未履約合約金額由三個月前的5,139億美元，增至5,608億美元，單季增加469億美元。其中168億美元來自與Crux AI簽訂的多年協議，約占單季增幅的36%。
Crux AI是Alphabet與黑石集團(BX-US)共同成立的事業，在申報文件中被列為關係人。Alphabet持有少數股權，並承諾提供最高100億美元的資料中心與能源相關擔保支持。
未履約合約通常被投資人視為未來營收成長的重要指標，但這次揭露顯示，部分新增需求來自Alphabet本身協助成立、並提供支持的企業，而非完全獨立的外部客戶。
Synovus Trust資深投資組合經理Dan Morgan表示，這讓雲端訂單成長的吸引力打了折扣；若訂單來自大量外部客戶，會更令人安心。他認為，投資人必須進一步檢視，這類需求是否存在企業自行扶植、再轉化為自身訂單的循環。
Morgan也指出，未來市場須更仔細分析雲端供應商的訂單結構，例如甲骨文(ORCL-US)大量未履約合約，就來自其本身也是重要參與者的資料中心合作計畫Stargate。

能源擔保倍增 部分TPU系統附買回安排

申報文件顯示，Alphabet能源相關擔保增加逾一倍至162億美元，相當於替合作夥伴購買昂貴電力設備提供信用支持，以供應資料中心所需。相關條款期限延伸至2049年1月，相較6月文件所列的2026年9月，大幅拉長。
此外，Alphabet可能須買回最多66億美元已售出的AI晶片系統。部分客戶有權按預先約定的折扣價格，將Google張量處理器(TPU)系統售回。Alphabet則表示，目前客戶沒有誘因行使這項權利。
支撐AI擴張的搜尋業務也出現壓力。第三季Google搜尋付費點擊次數年增8%，低於第二季的13%，儘管執行長皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)表示，搜尋查詢量增速創五年來最快。
商務長Philipp Schindler先前在電話會議說明，AI Mode查詢量強勁成長，但變現能力較低，因此影響營收表現。公司正擴大AI Mode廣告投放，並首次拓展至國際市場。

投資資產與AI代理風險同步浮現

Alphabet帳上2,651億美元現金與有價證券中，752億美元為附有短期出售限制的SpaceX股票，占比約28%。這也意味，不能將這筆資產總額全數視為可立即動用的現金。
公司私人持股上季產生約30億美元帳面收益，較第二季的774億美元大幅縮減。《彭博》先前辨識，這類持股主要為Anthropic股權。
在技術風險方面，Alphabet首次揭露，自主AI代理在模型測試期間，曾採取「超出預定範圍」的行動。公司正準備向Gemini應用程式的10億名使用者推出代理功能，相關揭露也讓部署安全與管理能力受到關注。
Alphabet對上述申報內容不予置評。
paras_en: Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US) disclosed in its latest filing that its AI investment risk extends beyond the previously announced over‑$1 trillion commitments for purchases, leases and other expenses, adding an additional roughly $98.5 billion of contingent obligations that could become actual liabilities under certain conditions. At the same time, the increase in Google Cloud’s Q3 non‑performance contract amount – more than a third of which comes from a joint venture Alphabet helped create – has prompted market scrutiny of order sources and growth quality.

Foreign media reported that Alphabet filed its quarterly report on Thursday (the 29th), revealing several AI‑related exposures that were not fully explained in the earnings call the day before. In addition to CFO Anat Ashkenazi’s previously disclosed over‑$1 trillion commitment, the filing lists a $98.5 billion contingent commitment, up about $23 billion from the prior quarter.

These arrangements include guarantees for data‑center rent, support for partners’ procurement of power equipment, and possible buy‑backs of AI chip systems from customers. The amounts are not all due debt yet, but they mean Alphabet assumes part of its partners’ operating and financing risk in addition to its own construction spend.

Cloud new orders – more than one‑third – come from related entities. As of the end of September, Google Cloud’s non‑performance contract amount rose from $513.9 billion three months earlier to $560.8 billion, a quarterly increase of $46.9 billion. Of that, $16.8 billion is tied to a multi‑year agreement with Crux AI, roughly 36% of the quarterly rise.

Crux AI is a venture jointly founded by Alphabet and Blackstone (BX‑US) and is listed as a related party in the filing. Alphabet holds a minority stake and has pledged up to $10 billion of data‑center and energy‑related guarantee support.

Non‑performance contracts are usually viewed by investors as a key indicator of future revenue growth, but this disclosure shows that part of the new demand comes from companies Alphabet helped create and support, rather than wholly independent external customers.

Senior portfolio manager Dan Morgan of Synovus Trust said this dampens the appeal of cloud‑order growth; if orders came from a broad base of external customers, it would be more reassuring. He believes investors need to examine whether such demand reflects a cycle of companies being nurtured and then turned into Alphabet’s own orders.

Morgan also noted that the market will need to scrutinize cloud providers’ order structures more closely, citing Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) large non‑performance contracts that stem from its own data‑center partnership program Stargate.

Energy guarantees more than double; some TPU systems include buy‑back provisions. The filing shows Alphabet’s energy‑related guarantees more than doubled to $16.2 billion, effectively providing credit support for partners to purchase expensive power equipment needed for data‑centers. The related terms now run through January 2049, a significant extension from the September 2026 deadline listed in the June filing.

In addition, Alphabet may have to buy back up to $6.6 billion of AI chip systems it has already sold. Certain customers have the right, at a pre‑agreed discounted price, to sell Google Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) systems back to Alphabet, which says customers currently have no incentive to exercise that right.

The search business that underpins AI expansion is also under pressure. In Q3, paid Google Search clicks grew 8% year‑over‑year, down from 13% in Q2, even though CEO Sundar Pichai said search query growth was the fastest in five years.

Chief Business Officer Philipp Schindler previously explained in the earnings call that AI Mode query volume is growing strongly but monetization is lower, hurting revenue performance. The company is expanding AI Mode ad placements and is launching them internationally for the first time.

Investment assets and AI‑agent risk surface together. Of Alphabet’s $265.1 billion in cash and marketable securities, $75.2 billion is in SpaceX stock subject to short‑sale restrictions, about 28% of the total, meaning that amount cannot be treated as fully available cash.

The company’s private‑equity holdings generated about $3 billion of book income last quarter, a sharp decline from $77.4 billion in Q2. Bloomberg previously identified these holdings as primarily Anthropic equity.

On the technology‑risk side, Alphabet disclosed for the first time that its autonomous AI agents took actions “beyond the intended scope” during model testing. The firm is preparing to roll out the agent feature to the 1 billion users of its Gemini app, raising concerns about deployment safety and governance.
Alphabet declined to comment on the filing contents.

items.title: 疑涉中國情報活動！黃仁勳身邊人士遭美方監控 輝達：客戶往來正常
items.title_en: Possible Chinese Spy Activity! Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Associate Under U.S. Surveillance, Nvidia Says Customer Interactions Normal
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)周四(29日)回應《紐約時報》(NYT)報導，針對美國情報機構懷疑一名與執行長黃仁勳關係密切的人士，可能替中國情報單位工作，公司強調黃仁勳與客戶互動並不異常，客戶也無法取得輝達商業機密或相關國安資訊。
《紐約時報》引述知悉情報監控情況的人士報導，與新加坡雲端業者Megaspeed有關聯的Alice Huang，與黃仁勳建立密切關係，引起美方情報機構關注。報導稱，美方擔憂她可能協助中國政府取得輝達及黃仁勳掌握的資訊，也關切黃仁勳能接觸美國總統川普。這些屬報導引述的情報疑慮，並非已獲證實的間諜身分。

輝達稱客戶往來正常 轉運疑雲去年已查清

輝達發言人向《CNBC》表示，Megaspeed只是公司眾多區域雲端客戶之一，黃仁勳每年與數千名客戶交流，與該公司人士互動並不特殊，客戶不會因此接觸到商業機密或相關國安資訊。
報導另指出，Megaspeed先前曾被懷疑協助企業規避美國對輝達AI晶片的出口管制，將受限制產品轉運至中國。
輝達對此表示，針對這家區域雲端業者的轉運指控，去年已經過徹底調查並遭駁斥。公司未在這份回應中詳述調查過程。
針對Alice Huang，輝達則表示，相信若美國政府認為任何人對美國產業構成威脅，就會通知公司，暗示未曾收到相關通報。這項說法與晶片轉運調查是不同事項，不能據此認定情報疑慮也已獲釐清。

AI晶片牽動美中角力 黃仁勳積極接觸川普

輝達AI晶片既是開發AI的重要工具，也成為美中科技競爭與經貿談判的焦點。部分政治人物及分析師擔憂，這些晶片可能被用於中國軍事AI模型，或協助中國商用模型與美國技術競爭。
隨著AI在政策中的重要性提升，黃仁勳與川普互動增加，曾共同出席國宴、AI峰會及海外行程，並強調建設美國AI基礎設施，同時爭取部分輝達晶片獲准銷往中國。
美國政府今年稍早批准H200晶片對中出口，但中國監管機關阻止進口。H200屬於Hopper架構，並非目前美國AI開發商採用、速度更快的Blackwell世代產品。
輝達發言人主張，中國政府並非透過Megaspeed等區域雲端業者尋求輝達產品，而是阻擋美國AI晶片，以保護本土產業。公司去年曾就中國市場特規AI晶片認列約45億美元減損，凸顯出口限制與市場准入政策對其業務的衝擊。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) on Thursday (the 29th) responded to a New York Times (NYT) report that U.S. intelligence agencies suspect a person close to CEO Jensen Huang may be working for Chinese intelligence; the company stressed that Huang’s interactions with customers are normal and that customers cannot obtain Nvidia’s trade secrets or related national‑security information.

The NYT, citing sources familiar with the surveillance, reported that Alice Huang, who is linked to Singapore cloud provider Megaspeed and has a close relationship with Jensen Huang, has drawn U.S. intelligence attention. The report said U.S. officials worry she could help the Chinese government obtain information held by Nvidia and Huang, and they are also concerned about Huang’s access to former President Donald Trump. These are reported intelligence concerns, not confirmed spy identities.

Nvidia said customer interactions are normal and the cloud‑service speculation was cleared last year. A Nvidia spokesperson told CNBC that Megaspeed is just one of many regional cloud customers, that Huang talks to thousands of customers each year, and that his dealings with the company’s personnel are unremarkable; customers do not gain access to trade secrets or national‑security data.
The report also noted that Megaspeed had previously been suspected of helping companies evade U.S. export controls on Nvidia AI chips by rerouting restricted products to China.

Nvidia said the allegations that the regional cloud provider was involved in such rerouting were thoroughly investigated and refuted last year, though the company did not detail the investigation in its response.

Regarding Alice Huang, Nvidia said it believes that if the U.S. government deemed any individual a threat to American industry it would notify the company, implying it has not received such a notice. This statement concerns a different matter from the chip‑rerouting probe and does not resolve the intelligence concerns.

AI chips are a focal point of U.S.–China rivalry, and Jensen Huang has been actively engaging with Donald Trump. Nvidia’s AI chips are essential tools for AI development and have become a centerpiece of the tech and trade competition between the two countries.

As AI’s policy importance grows, Huang’s interactions with Trump have increased; they have jointly attended state banquets, AI summits and overseas trips, with Huang emphasizing the building of U.S. AI infrastructure while also seeking approval for some Nvidia chips to be sold to China.

Earlier this year the U.S. government approved export of the H200 chip to China, but Chinese regulators blocked its import. The H200, based on the Hopper architecture, is not the newer, faster Blackwell generation currently used by U.S. AI developers.

A Nvidia spokesperson argued that the Chinese government is not seeking Nvidia products through regional cloud providers like Megaspeed, but is instead blocking U.S. AI chips to protect its domestic industry. The company recorded about $4.5 billion of impairment last year for special‑spec AI chips in the Chinese market, highlighting the impact of export restrictions and market‑access policies on its business.
