items.title: 不讓華爾街猜透！華許保留升息底牌 重塑Fed決策模式
items.title_en: Keeping Wall Street Guessing! Warsh Holds the Raising‑Rates Card, Reshapes Fed Decision‑Making Model
paras: 聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)正改變與市場溝通的方式。他周三在記者會上拒絕承諾固定政策路徑，同時暗示利率仍可能上升。分析指出，讓華爾街保持不確定性，可能成為他保留政策彈性、推動Fed改革的重要工具，但也引發決策透明度與延後緊縮風險的質疑。
華許上任初期，因川普曾將降息視為挑選Fed主席的重要條件，加上Fed在通膨明顯高於2%時，仍於6月與7月按兵不動，抗通膨決心一度受到挑戰。9月升息及其偏鷹派的經濟評估，才讓市場看法轉向。

拒絕承諾政策路徑 為12月升息保留空間

9月會議後，投資人一度認為Fed本周可能再升息，直到兩名高層官員出面降低市場預期。華許這次則明確否認政策已有既定方向，表示若對貨幣政策形成明確結論，就會當場宣布。
不過，他也釋出偏向升息的訊號，強調整體金融環境雖已收緊，卻仍不能稱為緊縮。這番話既保留選擇，也為通膨若持續頑固時，12月再度升息鋪路。
至於先前兩名官員是否奉命引導市場，華許拒絕證實。分析認為，市場確實接收到本次不升息的訊息，但華許未承認親自安排，使他能在避免直接承諾的同時，維持溝通彈性。
他也重申，Fed不會容忍通膨目標落在2%多的水準，目標就是2%。若經濟維持強勁，這項立場可能支持進一步升息；但12月會議前的新數據，也可能讓他主張生產力提高，容許經濟更快成長而不推升通膨。

減少利率表決次數 透明度與政策延誤受質疑

華許同時開始重塑Fed運作。他成立的專案小組，目標之一是改變通膨衡量方式；9月升息則有助回應外界對其抗通膨決心的質疑，為改革建立基礎。
他周三另宣布，未來兩年將減少預定利率表決次數。聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)仍每年開會八次，但2027年有一次會議、2028年有兩次會議不安排利率表決。
分析指出，這可能降低部分官員談話的市場影響力，因為發言與下次利率決策最多可能相隔約三個月；輪值投票的地區聯準銀行總裁，也會少掉部分原定表決機會。主席則仍可視需要隨時召開臨時會議。
然而，減少政策指引與表決機會，也引發透明度疑慮。PGIM美國首席經濟學家Robert Sockin認為，華許未充分解釋，為何在通膨偏高、金融環境尚未達緊縮程度下，本周仍選擇不升息。
Sockin直言，按兵不動是「政策錯誤」，過於漸進的Fed可能最終被迫將利率升得更高，增加衰退風險。華許的做法雖為改革與決策保留空間，但等待緊縮的代價，也可能直到難以及時補救時才浮現。
paras_en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is changing how he communicates with the market. At Wednesday's press conference he refused to commit to a fixed policy path while hinting that rates could still rise. Analysts say keeping Wall Street in uncertainty may be a tool for preserving policy flexibility and pushing Fed reforms, but it also raises questions about decision‑making transparency and the risk of delayed tightening.

Warsh’s early tenure was marked by Trump’s view that rate cuts were a key factor in selecting the Fed chair, and the Fed’s decision to stand pat in June and July even as inflation was clearly above 2%, challenging its anti‑inflation resolve. It was only after the September hike and his hawkish economic assessment that market sentiment shifted.

After the September meeting investors briefly thought the Fed might raise rates again this week, until two senior officials stepped in to temper expectations. This time Warsh explicitly denied that policy had a predetermined direction, saying that if a clear conclusion on monetary policy were reached it would be announced on the spot.

Nevertheless, he signaled a bias toward another hike, emphasizing that while the overall financial environment has tightened, it cannot yet be called restrictive. The comment leaves options open and paves the way for a possible December rate increase if inflation remains stubborn.

When asked whether the two officials were instructed to guide the market, Warsh declined to confirm. Analysts note the market did pick up the no‑hike signal, but Warsh’s refusal to acknowledge personal orchestration lets him maintain communication flexibility while avoiding a direct commitment.

He also reiterated that the Fed will not tolerate inflation running above its 2% target – the goal is exactly 2%. If the economy stays strong, this stance could support further hikes; however, new data before the December meeting could allow him to argue that productivity gains permit faster growth without pushing inflation higher.

Warsh is also reshaping Fed operations. A task force he created aims, among other things, to change how inflation is measured; the September hike helped address external doubts about the Fed’s anti‑inflation resolve and laid groundwork for reforms.

On Wednesday he announced that over the next two years the Fed will cut the number of scheduled rate‑vote meetings. The Federal Open Market Committee will still meet eight times a year, but in 2027 one meeting and in 2028 two meetings will not include a rate vote.

Analysts say this could reduce the market impact of some officials’ remarks, since comments may be spaced up to about three months from the next rate decision; rotating‑vote regional Fed presidents will also lose some of their scheduled voting opportunities. The chair, however, can still call emergency meetings as needed.

However, cutting policy guidance and voting opportunities also raises transparency concerns. PGIM U.S. chief economist Robert Sockin argues Warsh has not adequately explained why, with inflation still elevated and the financial environment not yet restrictive, the Fed chose to hold rates steady this week.

Sockin bluntly calls the hold a “policy mistake,” warning that an overly gradual Fed may eventually be forced to raise rates higher, increasing recession risk. Warsh’s approach may preserve reform space and decision‑making leeway, but the cost of delayed tightening could only become apparent when it is too late to remediate.

items.title: 一點風吹草動就可能再跌！美銀年底前避免重押 緊盯AI舉債風險
items.title_en: Even a Slight Breeze Could Trigger Another Drop! Bank of America Avoids Heavy Bets Before Year‑End, Watching AI Debt Risks Closely
paras: 熱門交易接連遭遇劇烈震盪，美國銀行(BAC-US)宏觀交易團隊正降低年底前的風險曝險，避免大舉押注。該行全球固定收益、外匯與大宗商品(FICC)宏觀交易共同主管Carlos Fernandez-Aller警告，市場相當脆弱，任何小意外都可能引發新一波部位平倉。
《彭博》周四(29日)報導，Fernandez-Aller在紐約辦公室接受訪問時表示，今年歐洲利率大幅波動，令宏觀基金尤其難以操作。新興市場投資人整體表現雖較好，但巴西總統魯拉意外勝選後引發的拋售，也讓市場見識到漲勢逆轉的速度。
他表示：「市場非常脆弱，任何小差錯，都可能讓先前看到的平倉潮延續。」因此，團隊目前承擔的風險相對有限。
近幾周，法國激烈政治抗議推升公債風險，一項衡量法債風險的指標升至歐債危機以來最高；魯拉連任則引發巴西貨幣周一創下逾20年來最大跌幅，凸顯政治事件對市場的衝擊。
利率市場同時受到多股力量拉扯，包括油價突破每桶110美元、經濟成長優於預期，以及各國政府債務不斷膨脹的疑慮。本月稍早，美國指標公債殖利率一度升至2002年以來最高。
美銀旗下FICC交易業務分為宏觀與微觀產品，第三季營收年減17%，主要受到房貸、市政債券與信用產品交易業務下滑拖累。
展望年底，Fernandez-Aller尤其關注信用利差。投資人愈來愈擔憂人工智慧(AI)交易前景，以及科技企業為支應投資而承擔的龐大債務，信用市場已出現避險訊號。
他表示，信用利差是自己密切追蹤的指標，可能成為市場「最後一隻落下的靴子」，意味若信用市場進一步惡化，可能引發下一波震盪。
不過，固定收益市場也出現一些變化，可能意味長天期政府公債殖利率逐漸接近上限。近期股市下跌或歐洲政治疑慮升高時，美國公債開始上漲，重新展現避險功能。
Fernandez-Aller將這項變化歸因於聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)強化抗通膨承諾。他認為，市場可能重新進入「壞消息就是好消息」的舊有模式，也就是疲弱經濟數據反而帶動市場上漲，而這是他近幾年少見的現象。
paras_en: Popular trades have been hit by sharp volatility, and Bank of America (BAC‑US) macro trading team is scaling back risk exposure before year‑end to avoid large bets. Carlos Fernandez‑Aller, co‑head of the bank’s global Fixed Income, Currencies and Commodities (FICC) macro trading, warned that markets are very fragile and any small mishap could spark a new wave of position liquidations.

Bloomberg reported on Thursday (the 29th) that Fernandez‑Aller said in an interview from the New York office that this year’s European rate swings have made macro funds especially hard to manage. Emerging‑market investors have performed relatively well overall, but the sell‑off triggered by Brazil’s President Lula’s surprise re‑election showed how quickly a rally can reverse.
He said, “The market is extremely fragile; any small error could prolong the liquidation wave we’ve already seen.” As a result, the team’s current risk exposure is relatively limited.

In recent weeks, intense political protests in France have pushed sovereign‑bond risk higher, with a French‑bond risk gauge hitting its highest level since the Euro‑zone debt crisis; Lula’s re‑election also caused the Brazilian real on Monday to record its biggest drop in over 20 years, highlighting the impact of political events on markets.

The rates market is being pulled in multiple directions, including oil prices breaking above $110 per barrel, stronger‑than‑expected economic growth, and concerns over ever‑expanding sovereign debt. Earlier this month, U.S. benchmark Treasury yields briefly rose to their highest level since 2002.

Bank of America’s FICC trading business is split between macro and micro products, and third‑quarter revenue fell 17% year‑over‑year, mainly due to weakness in mortgage, municipal bond and credit product trading.

Looking toward year‑end, Fernandez‑Aller is especially focused on credit spreads. Investors are increasingly worried about the outlook for AI‑driven trading and the massive debt tech companies are taking on to fund investments, sending a hedging signal through the credit market.

He said credit spreads are a metric he watches closely and could be the market’s “last falling boot,” meaning that if the credit market deteriorates further it could trigger the next wave of turbulence.

However, the fixed‑income market is showing some shifts that may signal long‑dated government bond yields are edging toward a ceiling. When equities have fallen recently or European political worries have risen, U.S. Treasuries have started to climb, re‑asserting their safe‑haven role.

Fernandez‑Aller attributes this shift to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s reinforced anti‑inflation commitment. He believes the market may revert to the old “bad news is good news” pattern, where weak economic data actually lifts markets—a phenomenon he has rarely seen in recent years.

items.title: 不只股價跌慘！Google違約保險也變貴 AI投資回報再受質疑
items.title_en: Not Just a Stock Crash! Google’s Credit Default Insurance Also Gets More Expensive, AI Investment Returns Again Questioned
paras: Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)財報不如預期，不僅引發股價重挫，也推升債務違約保險成本。投資人愈來愈擔憂，公司透過舉債支持的龐大人工智慧(AI)投資，能否帶來足夠回報，相關壓力也波及其他科技企業。
《彭博》引述ICE Data Services數據報導，Google債務的5年期信用違約交換(CDS)利差，周四(29日)一度上升5.3個基點至84個基點，創9月21日以來最大升幅。臉書母公司Meta(META-US)與晶片大廠博通(AVGO-US)的CDS成本也同步走高。
CDS是投資人用來對沖債務違約損失的工具，成本上升通常反映市場要求更高的信用風險補償，但不等同企業即將違約。
Alphabet第三季營收低於市場預期，其中廣告營收成長速度降至一年多來最低。廣告業務是支應公司大規模AI投資的重要資金來源，因此成長放緩，也讓債券投資人更加關注資本支出與現金流之間的落差。
標普全球市場財智固定收益定價執行董事Gavan Nolan表示，若AI投資成功，股票投資人可能獲得豐厚報酬；但若投資失利，債權人也必須承擔損失風險。因此，債券投資人正緊盯資本支出，以及AI業務何時能產生正向自由現金流。
Nolan指出，就科技產業而言，信用市場在某種程度上，正傳遞與股票市場不同的訊息。
科技企業CDS交易也明顯升溫。巴克萊信用策略師Jigar Patel分析交易資料庫後指出，截至上周，與10家最大超大規模雲端業者及晶片製造商相關的CDS，今年交易量已增至去年的逾8倍，達1,760億美元。部分企業的CDS，例如SpaceX，直到最近幾個月才開始交易。
其中，甲骨文(ORCL-US)的CDS交易最活躍，2026年交易量已增至去年的近6倍，達468億美元。隨著AI建設日益仰賴外部融資，信用市場正成為投資人衡量科技業支出風險的重要觀察窗口。
paras_en: Alphabet, Google’s parent company (GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US), reported earnings that fell short of expectations, triggering a sharp drop in its share price and pushing up the cost of debt‑default insurance. Investors are increasingly worried whether the massive AI investments funded by borrowing will generate sufficient returns, and the pressure is spilling over to other tech firms.

Bloomberg, citing ICE Data Services, reported that the five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spread on Google’s debt rose by 5.3 basis points on Thursday (the 29th) to 84 basis points, the biggest increase since September 21. The CDS costs for Meta (META‑US), Facebook’s parent, and chip giant Broadcom (AVGO‑US) also climbed in tandem.

CDS contracts are tools investors use to hedge against debt‑default losses; a higher cost usually reflects the market demanding greater compensation for credit risk, but it does not mean the company is about to default.

Alphabet’s third‑quarter revenue missed market forecasts, with advertising revenue growth slowing to its lowest pace in more than a year. Advertising is a key source of funding for the company’s large‑scale AI investments, so the slowdown has heightened bond investors’ focus on the gap between capital spending and cash flow.

Gavan Nolan, Managing Director of Fixed‑Income Pricing at S&P Global Market Intelligence, said that if AI investments succeed, equity investors could reap generous rewards; but if they fail, creditors also face loss risk. Consequently, bond investors are closely watching capital expenditures and when AI operations might generate positive free cash flow.
Nolan noted that, for the technology sector, the credit market is, to some extent, conveying a message that differs from that of the equity market.

Barclays credit strategist Jigar Patel, after analyzing trading data, said that as of last week, CDS trading linked to the ten largest hyperscale cloud providers and chip makers has surged to more than eight times last year’s volume, reaching $176 billion. Some companies’ CDS contracts, such as SpaceX, only began trading in recent months.

Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) CDS activity was the most vigorous, with 2026‑dated contracts rising to nearly six times last year’s level, amounting to $46.8 billion. As AI infrastructure increasingly relies on external financing, the credit market is becoming a key window for investors to gauge spending risk in the tech industry.

items.title: 拉加德提前走人！ECB接班兩強浮現 誰來接招通膨與法債風險？
items.title_en: Lagarde Leaves Early! Two Strong Candidates Emerge to Lead the ECB Amid Inflation and French Debt Risks
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)周四(29日)宣布，將於2027年2月7日提前卸任，比原訂同年10月底任期屆滿提早近九個月。此舉讓接班競逐進入關鍵階段，前西班牙央行總裁戴柯斯(Pablo Hernández de Cos)與前荷蘭央行總裁諾特(Klaas Knot)被視為最有力人選。
綜合《CNBC》與《彭博》報導，歐洲理事會主席柯斯塔(António Costa)表示，繼任者遴選程序將立即展開。歐元區21個成員國可能力爭年底前達成共識，並一併協商明年即將出缺的ECB首席經濟學家與執行理事職位。
拉加德在ECB公布最新利率決策前宣布辭職，感謝團隊過去七年的支持，並獲管理委員會起立鼓掌。她任內歷經疫情、俄烏戰爭與能源價格衝擊；如今歐元區9月通膨再攀三年高點，接班人仍須面對物價與金融穩定的雙重考驗。

戴柯斯民調領先 諾特具金融穩定經驗

現年55歲、目前掌舵國際清算銀行(BIS)的戴柯斯，在《彭博》分析師調查中居於領先。他已獲西班牙總理桑傑士支持，可能在11月29日提前大選勝出的中間偏右人民黨，也表態支持他，降低政黨輪替對提名的影響。
戴柯斯過去被視為偏鴿派，但若提前離開BIS，可能引發對該機構聲譽及接班安排的疑慮，成為競逐ECB職位的阻力。
59歲的諾特則於8月獲荷蘭政府正式提名。他曾任金融穩定委員會(FSB)主席，相關經驗被認為有助應對債市動盪。不過，他自2025年中卸任荷蘭央行總裁後已離開決策第一線一段時間，加上荷蘭過去已出過ECB總裁，可能影響各國支持意願。
諾特原被視為鷹派，曾反對前總裁德拉吉的部分寬鬆政策，之後立場逐漸溫和。他本月仍表示，經濟與地緣政治衝擊可能要求ECB未來幾年略偏向緊縮。

法國債務風險升溫 接班角力牽動政策方向

接班安排不僅涉及專業能力，也牽涉國籍、區域與性別平衡。德國央行總裁內格爾(Joachim Nagel)、義大利央行總裁帕內塔(Fabio Panetta)，以及歐洲投資銀行總裁卡爾維尼奧(Nadia Calviño)，也曾被點名；卡爾維尼奧已否認參選意願，但仍有人認為，各國可能尋求另一名女性接任。
新總裁除須讓通膨回到2%，也得處理法國債務壓力與歐元區公債利差擴大的風險。法國明年總統大選更添變數，市場正討論ECB是否可能動用干預工具。
《彭博》經濟研究認為，相較戴柯斯，諾特可能採取較緊的貨幣政策，對干預法國債市也較不積極。Berenberg首席經濟學家Holger Schmieding則指出，諾特的金融穩定經驗可能成為優勢，但ECB無意替法國失衡的財政政策埋單。
至於拉加德下一步，英國《金融時報》(FT)曾報導，她是世界經濟論壇下一任主席的熱門人選；她近期則暗示，無意角逐2027年法國總統。
paras_en: ECB President Christine Lagarde announced on Thursday the 29th that she will step down early on February 7, 2027, nearly nine months before her term was set to end in late October 2027. Her early departure pushes the succession race into a critical phase, with former Spanish central bank governor Pablo Hernández de Cos and former Dutch central bank governor Klaas Knot seen as the strongest contenders.

According to reports from CNBC and Bloomberg, European Council President António Costa said the selection process for her successor will start immediately. The 21 euro‑area member states are expected to strive for a consensus by the end of the year and will also negotiate the appointments for the ECB’s chief economist and an executive board seat that will become vacant next year.

Lagarde resigned just before the ECB announced its latest rate decision, thanking her team for seven years of support and receiving a standing ovation from the management board. Her tenure spanned the pandemic, the Russia‑Ukraine war and energy price shocks; now euro‑area inflation in September has climbed to a three‑year high, and her successor will still have to face the dual challenge of price stability and financial stability.

At 55, de Cos, who now heads the Bank for International Settlements, leads a Bloomberg analyst poll. He has the backing of Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and the centre‑right People’s Party, which is expected to win an early election on November 29, further reducing the impact of a change of government on his nomination.

De Cos has previously been viewed as dovish, but an early departure from the BIS could raise concerns about the institution’s reputation and succession plan, potentially becoming a hurdle in the race for the ECB chairmanship.

The 59‑year‑old Knot was formally nominated by the Dutch government in August. He previously chaired the Financial Stability Board, experience seen as useful for dealing with bond‑market turbulence. However, he left the front line of decision‑making after stepping down as Dutch central bank governor in mid‑2025, and the fact that the Netherlands has already produced an ECB president may affect the level of support from other countries.

Knot was originally seen as a hawk, having opposed some of former President Draghi’s easing measures, but his stance has gradually softened. He said this month that economic and geopolitical shocks could require the ECB to tilt slightly more towards tightening over the next few years.

The succession not only involves professional competence but also considerations of nationality, regional balance and gender. Germany’s central bank president Joachim Nagel, Italy’s central bank governor Fabio Panetta and European Investment Bank president Nadia Calviño have also been mentioned; Calviño has denied any interest in running, yet some argue that countries may still look for another woman to take the role.

The new president will have to bring inflation back to 2% while also dealing with French debt pressures and the risk of widening sovereign‑bond spreads across the euro area. France’s presidential election next year adds further uncertainty, and markets are debating whether the ECB might resort to intervention tools.

Bloomberg’s economic research suggests that, compared with de Cos, Knot may pursue a tighter monetary stance and be less inclined to intervene in the French bond market. Berenberg chief economist Holger Schmieding notes that Knot’s financial‑stability background could be an advantage, but the ECB has no intention of footing the bill for France’s imbalanced fiscal policy.

As for Lagarde’s next move, the Financial Times reported that she is a leading candidate to become the next chair of the World Economic Forum; she has recently hinted that she has no intention of running for the French presidency in 2027.

items.title: 印尼央行積極護盤 印尼盾連跌6日後迎來反彈
items.title_en: Indonesia Central Bank Actively Supports Market as Rupiah Rebounds After Six Days of Decline
paras: 印尼盾(IDR)在經歷連續6個交易日下跌後，周四(29日)強勁反彈，以擺脫在歷史低點附近徘徊。
美元兌印尼盾匯率自 10 月 27 日創下的近5個月高點 18,223 回落，盤中一度走軟至 18,185，隨後回升至 18,108 至 18,127 區間，跌幅達 0.4%，有望創下自 9 月 30 日以來的最大單日跌幅。
FXStreet 分析師 Akhtar Faruqui 指出，印尼盾走強主要受到印尼中央銀行積極護盤的支撐。印尼央行重申，將持續透過無本金交割遠期外匯(NDF)、國內無本金交割遠期外匯(DNDF)、現貨市場干預，以及在次級市場購入國債等多重工具以穩定匯市。
外部環境方面，美國聯準會決議將基準利率維持在 3.75%–4.00% 不變。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)發表談話時重申，公開市場委員會(FOMC)將堅守物價穩定與 2% 的通膨目標，並強調底層經濟成長依然強勁。
不過此項利率決策並未獲得全體一致同意，聯準會理事庫克(Lisa Cook)與克里夫蘭Fed主席哈馬克(Beth Hammack)投下反對票，主張應立即升息1碼(25 個基點)以應對居高不下的物價壓力。華許更為溫和的表態被市場解讀為偏向鴿派，進一步推升了亞洲主要貨幣。
儘管央行出手干預，印尼當地金融市場仍承受顯著壓力。印尼 10 年期公債殖利率一度攀升至7.7%–7.707% 的近年新高，顯著高於 2026 財年預算設定的 6.9% 基準，隨後微幅下降 3 個基點至 7.62%。
由於市場對財政風險及通膨隱憂未除，加上印尼在 MSCI 指數中面臨可能被降級為獨立市場狀態的不確定性，導致外資持續賣超並引發資本外流疑慮。雅加達綜合指數仍下挫 2% 至 5,175.15 點。
交易員目前正密切關注即將公布的 9 月貿易數據與 10 月通膨報告，以評估後續經濟與匯率走勢。
paras_en: The Indonesian rupiah (IDR) staged a strong rebound on Thursday (the 29th) after six consecutive trading days of decline, shaking off its slide near historic lows.

The USD/IDR rate fell from the near‑five‑month high of 18,223 set on October 27, slipping intraday to as low as 18,185 before climbing back into the 18,108‑18,127 range, a drop of about 0.4% that could mark the biggest single‑day decline since September 30.

FXStreet analyst Akhtar Faruqui said the rupiah’s strength is mainly backed by the Bank Indonesia’s active market‑support measures. The central bank reiterated it will continue to use a mix of non‑deliverable forwards (NDF), domestic NDFs (DNDF), spot market interventions and purchases of government bonds in the secondary market to stabilise the exchange rate.

On the external front, the U.S. Federal Reserve kept its policy rate unchanged at 3.75%‑4.00%. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, in his remarks, reaffirmed that the Federal Open Market Committee will stay committed to price stability and a 2% inflation target, stressing that underlying economic growth remains robust.

However, the rate decision was not unanimous; Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack voted against it, arguing for an immediate 25‑basis‑point hike to curb persistent inflation pressures. Warsh’s more dovish tone was read by markets as a tilt toward easing, further lifting major Asian currencies.

Despite the central bank’s intervention, Indonesia’s domestic financial markets remain under significant strain. The 10‑year government bond yield briefly spiked to a recent high of 7.7%‑7.707%, well above the 6.9% benchmark set in the FY2026 budget, before easing by three basis points to 7.62%.

Because fiscal‑risk and inflation concerns persist, and Indonesia faces the possibility of being reclassified as a frontier market in MSCI indices, foreign investors continue to sell, raising worries about capital outflows. The Jakarta Composite Index fell another 2% to 5,175.15 points.
Traders are now closely watching the upcoming September trade data and October inflation report to gauge the next moves in the economy and the rupiah.

items.title: 歐洲央行料將維持利率不變 以評估法國動盪及能源風險
items.title_en: ECB Expected to Keep Rates Unchanged to Assess French Turmoil and Energy Risks
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(29日)預計將基準存款利率維持在 2.50% 不變，暫緩升息步伐。儘管中東伊朗衝突引發原油價格震盪與通膨隱憂，但在歐元區經濟動態放緩與法國國債市場劇烈波動的雙重夾擊下，決策者普遍選擇維持政策現狀，並將目光投向 12 月的政策展望。
歐元區當前通膨率接近 4%，遠高於 2% 的政策目標，但升幅主要集中於能源領域。彭博經濟研究(Bloomberg Economics)分析師David Powell與Simona Delle Chiaie指出：「歐洲央行幾乎肯定會在本次會議暫停升息；借貸成本上升已收緊金融條件，面對主權債券市場動盪，決策者希望避免火上澆油。」
德國貝倫貝格銀行首席經濟學家Holger Schmieding表示：「歐洲央行可能會表明，近期油價再度飆升，使通膨上行風險比 9 月時更為顯著。」
歐洲央行管理委員會委員Pierre Wunsch指出，市場預估央行未來將採取更多行動「是合理的基準情境，但全球仍處於極具不確定性的環境中」。貨幣市場目前定價年底前仍可能重啟升息，預估存款利率最終可能推升至 3.25%。
除了貨幣政策路線，法國公債市場的動盪成為即時挑戰。受預算赤字膨脹、政治分歧與社會動盪影響，法國 10 年期國債殖利率升破 5%，創下 24 年新高，與德國基準公債的利差亦擴大至 15 年新高。
針對央行是否干預，法國安盛集團(AXA Group)首席經濟學家Gilles Moec認為：「保留歐洲央行干預市場的可能性至關重要。」
但是，Lombard Odier歐洲、中東及非洲地區投資長Nannette Hechler-Fayd'Herbe強調：「干預門檻相當高，除非真的面臨擴散風險、金融市場運作失序或全歐流動性緊縮，否則不預計歐央行會動用傳播保護工具(TPI)。」
Algebris 基金管理公司經濟學家團隊分析，目前法國風險仍侷限於國內，若發生溢出效應，央行可能考慮對其他成員國啟用 TPI，但對法國保持立場。
市場同時高度關注歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)的去留問題，傳聞指出拉加德可能提前接任世界經濟論壇(WEF)主席。日本三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深經濟學家Henry Cook警告：「在央行面臨金融條件收緊、能源價格上漲及總體經濟前景不確定性升級之際，領導層出現任何不確定性都絕非理想狀況。」
目前荷蘭前央行總裁 Klaas Knot 與西班牙前央行總裁 Pablo Hernandez de Cos 被視為接任歐洲央行總裁的熱門人選。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) on Thursday (the 29th) is expected to keep its key deposit rate at 2.50%, pausing its rate‑hiking cycle. Despite oil price swings and inflation concerns sparked by the Middle‑East conflict involving Iran, policymakers are broadly opting to maintain the status quo amid slowing euro‑area economic activity and sharp volatility in the French sovereign bond market, turning their attention to the policy outlook for December.

Euro‑area inflation is currently close to 4%, well above the 2% target, but the rise is largely confined to energy. Bloomberg Economics analysts David Powell and Simona Delle Chiaie note, “The ECB is almost certain to pause rate hikes at this meeting; higher borrowing costs have already tightened financial conditions, and facing sovereign‑bond market turbulence, policymakers want to avoid adding fuel to the fire.”
Germany’s Berenberg Bank chief economist Holger Schmieding said, “The ECB may point out that the recent surge in oil prices makes inflation‑upside risks more pronounced than they were in September.”

ECB Governing Council member Pierre Wunsch said that market expectations of further ECB action “are a reasonable baseline scenario, but the world remains highly uncertain.” Money markets are still pricing in the possibility of a rate hike before year‑end, with the deposit rate potentially climbing to 3.25% eventually.

Beyond monetary policy, turbulence in the French sovereign‑bond market is an immediate challenge. Driven by a widening budget deficit, political divisions and social unrest, the yield on France’s 10‑year bond has broken above 5%, a 24‑year high, while the spread over German benchmark bonds has widened to a 15‑year peak.
Regarding possible ECB intervention, AXA Group chief economist Gilles Moec said, “Keeping the option of ECB market intervention open is crucial.”

However, Lombard Odier’s head of investment for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Nannette Hechler‑Fayd’Herbe, stressed, “The intervention threshold is quite high; unless there is a genuine spill‑over risk, a breakdown in market functioning, or a Europe‑wide liquidity squeeze, the ECB is not expected to deploy its Transmission Protection Instrument (TPI).”

Algebris fund‑management economists argue that French risk remains largely domestic; if spill‑over effects emerge, the ECB might consider using TPI for other member states, but would maintain its stance on France.

Markets are also closely watching the fate of ECB President Christine Lagarde, with rumours that she could take over the World Economic Forum (WEF) chairmanship ahead of schedule. Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group senior economist Henry Cook warned, “When the central bank faces tighter financial conditions, rising energy prices and escalating macro‑economic uncertainty, any uncertainty about its leadership is far from ideal.”
Former Dutch central‑bank governor Klaas Knot and former Spanish central‑bank governor Pablo Hernández de Cos are currently seen as the leading candidates to succeed Lagarde as ECB president.

items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Fed Holds Rates Steady, Dollar Gains Lose Momentum
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國9月新屋銷售下降，但人工智能(AI)投資熱潮注入動力，企業設備支出強勁增長及耐久財訂單增幅超過預期，而且10月消費者信心指數上升，突顯經濟狀況良好及通貨膨脹上行風險，市場普遍預計美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)週三維持利率不變，並暗示12月調整利率，提供美元支撐，但日本趨勢通貨膨脹指數創三年高位，鞏固日本央行(BOJ)升息理由，而且日本公債收益率上升及月末資金流入，週三推低美元兌日圓至157.63低點。

隨著也門戰事持續，外界擔憂中東能源進一步受擾提升油價，美元仍保持避險貨幣地位，而且儘管日本政府一再否認，但其整體立場偏向再通貨膨脹，可能設法推遲BOJ升息，令日圓承壓，美元兌日圓升至158.34高點。隨後美國公布9月商品貿易逆差意外擴大至1,349億美元，並據FED以10票贊成、理事庫克和克利夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈馬克主張加息25個基點，如預期維持聯邦基金利率區間在3.75%-4.00%，而且FED主席沃什在新聞會表示，經濟成長強勁的和通貨膨脹高企，未來仍可能再收緊貨幣政策，芝加哥商品交易所（CME）的FedWatch工具則顯示FED在12月加息的機率85%，但本次會議結果已在廣泛預期中，引發美元兌日圓回落。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於157.50-70，阻力於158.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

昨日澳洲公布第三季消費者物價指數(CPI)較前季升1.3%及較上年同期漲3.9%，澳洲央行(RBA)總裁布洛克則警告物價壓力仍居高不下，政策制定者將於下周討論今年四次升息是否足以實現通貨膨脹目標，提升RBA下週二加息25個基點的機率至88%，但紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)意外維持利率不變，儘管稱未來或仍需收緊政策，引發紐元暴跌，並據德國報告稱，受中國需求轉弱拖累出口，今年德國對亞太地區二十九個經濟體的出口料下降3.2%至1,853億歐元，對亞太貿易逆差料創紀錄高位，推低歐元兌美元至1.1131低點。
據紐倫堡市場決策研究所(NIM)與市場研究機構GfK調查，德國11月消費者信心指數下滑至負30.8，但歐洲央行(ECB)週四的政策會議預計維持利率不變，市場關注ECB對能源價格推動的第二輪通貨膨脹效應提供任何暗示，而且FED決議後美元走弱，歐元兌美元反彈至1.1169高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1140-60，支撐於1.1060-80。
◆GBP/USD

週三英國財政大臣希利料公布審慎的預算計畫，試圖避免讓首相伯納姆的新政府面臨更大的債券市場壓力，市場關注政府如何增加財政收入以支持經濟增長，但英國財政狀況可能比許多歐洲國家緊張，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3269低點，隨著英國財政大臣約翰希利公布首相伯納姆政府的首份財政預算，承諾堅持政府的財政規則，同時向英國家庭發放小額直接補貼及降低食品雜貨關稅，以緩解能源價格上漲衝擊，市場反應正向，提振英鎊兌美元至1.3338高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3315-35，支撐於1.3230-50。

U.S. September new‑home sales fell, but a surge in artificial‑intelligence (AI) investment is providing a boost, corporate equipment spending is rising strongly and durable‑goods orders are growing faster than expected. In addition, the October consumer confidence index rose, highlighting a solid economic backdrop and upward inflation risks. The market broadly expects the Federal Reserve to keep rates unchanged on Wednesday and signal a possible rate adjustment in December, which would support the dollar. Meanwhile, Japan’s trend inflation index hit a three‑year high, reinforcing the Bank of Japan’s case for tightening. Higher Japanese government‑bond yields and end‑of‑month fund inflows pushed the dollar‑yen down to a low of 157.63 on Wednesday.

As the war in Yemen drags on, concerns that Middle‑East energy supplies could be further disrupted and push oil prices higher keep the dollar in safe‑haven mode. Although the Japanese government repeatedly denies it, its overall stance leans toward re‑inflation, which could help delay BOJ rate hikes, putting pressure on the yen and lifting the dollar‑yen to a high of 158.34. Later, the U.S. reported an unexpectedly large September goods‑trade deficit of $134.9 billion. The Fed, with ten votes in favor, saw Chairman Cook and Cleveland Fed President Harker argue for a 25‑basis‑point hike, but the expectation remains to keep the federal funds rate in the 3.75‑4.00 % range. Fed Chair Waller said in a news conference that strong growth and high inflation could lead to further monetary tightening. The CME FedWatch tool shows an 85 % probability of a December rate hike. The meeting outcome was widely anticipated, prompting the dollar‑yen to retreat. The dollar‑yen is expected to find support around 157.50‑70 and face resistance near 158.30‑50 today.
EUR/USD

Yesterday Australia released its Q3 consumer price index, up 1.3 % from the previous quarter and 3.9 % year‑on‑year. RBA Governor Philip Lowe warned that price pressures remain high, and policymakers will discuss next week whether four rate hikes this year are enough to meet the inflation target, raising the odds of a 25‑basis‑point hike on Tuesday to 88 %. In contrast, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand unexpectedly left rates unchanged, though it said further tightening may be needed, sending the kiwi tumbling. A German report said that weaker Chinese demand is dragging down exports, with Germany’s exports to 29 Asia‑Pacific economies projected to fall 3.2 % to €185.3 billion, and the trade deficit with the region likely to hit a record high, pushing the euro‑dollar down to a low of 1.1131.

According to the Nürnberg Institute for Market Decision (NIM) and market research firm GfK, German consumer confidence fell to –30.8 in November. The ECB is expected to keep rates unchanged at Thursday’s policy meeting, and markets are watching for any hints about a second‑round inflation effect from energy prices. After the Fed decision, the dollar weakened and the euro rose to a high of 1.1169 against the dollar. The euro‑dollar is projected to face resistance around 1.1140‑60 and support near 1.1060‑80 today.
GBP/USD

On Wednesday UK Chancellor Jeremy Hunt is expected to unveil a cautious budget aimed at preventing Prime Minister Rishi Sunak’s new government from facing greater bond‑market pressure. Markets are watching how the government will raise fiscal revenue to support growth, but the UK’s fiscal situation may be tighter than many European peers, pushing the pound‑dollar down to a low of 1.3269. After Hunt announced the Sunak government’s first budget, pledging to stick to fiscal rules, provide modest direct subsidies to households and cut food‑grocery tariffs to ease the impact of rising energy prices, the market reacted positively, lifting the pound‑dollar to a high of 1.3338. The pound‑dollar is expected to encounter resistance around 1.3315‑35 and support near 1.3230‑50 today.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走貶 Fed如預期維持利率不變
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Weakens as Fed Holds Rates as Expected
paras: 美元周三(28日)兌主要貨幣走跌，聯準會(Fed)公布符合市場預期的利率決策。另一方面，紐西蘭央行意外決定維持利率不變，導致紐西蘭幣大幅下跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報102.15。
聯準會一如預期維持利率不變，選擇等到下週美國期中選舉結束後，再決定是否調整借貸成本，同時等待更多通膨走勢的相關數據。
聯準會公布決策後，美元短線反應平淡，但隨著主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在記者會上發言，美元隨後開始走弱。
歐元兌美元上漲0.32%，至1.1160美元。
美元兌日元下跌0.04%，至157.87日元。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師Marc Chandler表示，「由於殖利率曲線趨陡，美元比聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前更為疲軟。」
華許開始舉行記者會後，美國公債殖利率曲線趨陡。其中，通常隨聯準會利率預期變動的2年期公債殖利率下跌1.46個基點，至4.722%。
根據芝商所（CME）FedWatch工具，目前市場預期聯準會12月升息的機率接近85%。
Ocean Park Asset Management投資長James St. Aubin表示，「這次會議的結果完全符合市場預期，升息的可能性原本就不高。」
英國財政大臣John Healey週三向國會表示，政府將提高銀行、博弈業者、儲蓄者及房東的稅負，同時收緊亞馬遜等線上市場平台的加值型營業稅規定，以籌措英國預算方案所需資金。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.12%，至1.3323美元。
英鎊兌歐元則下跌約0.08%。
紐西蘭幣重挫
紐西蘭央行將利率維持在2.75%，令原本預期央行將升息的多數經濟學家感到意外。消息公布後，紐幣一度下跌1.74%，至0.5583美元。
加拿大央行則是三年多來首度調升政策利率，並表示，為避免能源成本飆升進一步推升整體通膨，未來可能還需要繼續升息。
加拿大幣兌美元上漲0.37%，至每美元兌1.4加幣。
Chandler表示，「紐西蘭央行的決策令市場失望，紐幣因此遭到拋售，也是G10貨幣中表現最弱貨幣。加拿大央行剛剛升息，但這項決策符合市場預期，因此加幣對升息的反應不大。」
市場預期，歐洲央行(ECB)與日本央行(BoJ)將分別於週四及週五公布貨幣政策決策，兩家央行都預計將維持政策利率不變。

paras_en: The dollar fell against major currencies on Wednesday (the 28th) as the Federal Reserve announced a rate decision that matched market expectations. Meanwhile, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand unexpectedly left rates unchanged, sending the New Zealand dollar sharply lower.
In the late New York session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.2% to 102.15.
The Fed, as anticipated, kept rates steady, opting to wait until after next week’s U.S. midterm elections before deciding whether to adjust borrowing costs, while also awaiting more inflation data.
After the Fed’s decision, the dollar’s short‑term reaction was muted, but it began to weaken after Chair Kevin Warsh spoke at the press conference.
The euro rose 0.32% against the dollar, to $1.1160.
The dollar fell 0.04% against the yen, to ¥157.87.
Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “With the yield curve steepening, the dollar is weaker than it was before the FOMC meeting.”
Following Warsh’s press briefing, the U.S. Treasury yield curve steepened. The two‑year Treasury yield, which usually moves with Fed rate expectations, dropped 1.46 basis points to 4.722%.
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market now sees an almost 85% chance of a rate hike by the Fed in December.
James St. Aubin, chief investment officer at Ocean Park Asset Management, said, “The outcome of this meeting was fully in line with market expectations; the likelihood of a hike was never high.”

U.K. Treasury Secretary John Healey told Parliament on Wednesday that the government will raise taxes on banks, gambling operators, savers and landlords, and tighten value‑added tax rules for online platforms such as Amazon to fund the budget.
The pound rose 0.12% against the dollar, to $1.3323.
The pound fell about 0.08% against the euro.
New Zealand dollar crashes
The Reserve Bank of New Zealand kept its policy rate at 2.75%, surprising most economists who had expected a hike. After the announcement, the kiwi dropped as much as 1.74% to $0.5583.

The Bank of Canada, for the first time in more than three years, raised its policy rate and warned that further hikes may be needed to prevent soaring energy costs from pushing overall inflation higher.
The Canadian dollar rose 0.37% against the U.S. dollar, to C$1.40 per dollar.

Chandler added, “The RBNZ’s decision disappointed the market, leading to a sell‑off of the kiwi, which became the weakest among G10 currencies. The BoC’s hike was expected, so the Canadian dollar’s reaction was muted.”
Markets expect the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) to announce their monetary‑policy decisions on Thursday and Friday, respectively, with both likely to keep rates unchanged.

items.title: 油價居高不下的代價！加拿大央行升息1碼 可能還得再升
items.title_en: The High Cost of Rising Oil Prices! Bank of Canada Raises Rates by One Quarter Point, May Need More
paras: 加拿大央行周三(28日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將基準隔夜利率提高至2.5%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，符合市場預期。央行警告，中東戰事推升能源價格，可能進一步擴散至其他商品與服務，未來仍可能需要升息，但考量經濟與地緣政治的不確定性，將謹慎行事。

防堵能源成本擴散 通膨回歸目標延至2028年

加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)表示，通膨展望明顯升高，加上經濟展現韌性，有必要調高利率，降低能源價格上漲演變為全面性通膨的風險。決策委員會認為，通膨風險增加，貨幣政策維持寬鬆的空間已縮小。
加拿大9月通膨率升至3.2%，超出央行1%至3%的目標區間，主要來自能源與相關運輸成本。央行預估，通膨年底將達3.5%，明年多數時間維持約3%，直到2028年中才回到接近2%的目標。
央行同步將2027年平均通膨預測，由7月估計的2%大幅上修至3.1%。馬克林指出，過往經驗與企業調查顯示，未來一年成本轉嫁程度將提高，使能源漲價對通膨的影響更持久。
不過，決策委員會也討論過維持利率不變，理由包括物價壓力仍集中於能源、經濟尚有閒置產能，以及美加關稅爭端可能拖累成長。馬克林強調，未來將逐次會議評估政策，未承諾連續升息。

經濟展望上修 關稅與就業疲弱仍構成風險

加拿大央行將今年經濟成長預測由0.7%上修至1%，並將2027年及2028年預測，由各1.8%提高至2%。聯邦政府推動的生產力投資抵減措施與重大建設，是支撐成長的部分原因。
短期動能仍可能放緩。央行預估，經濟成長年率將從第二季的3.3%，降至第三季的2%，第四季再降至0.8%，反映美國新增關稅的衝擊。馬克林預期，2027年可望隨消費支出延續、出口回升及企業投資增強而恢復動能，逐步吸收閒置產能。
然而，加拿大就業人數已連續兩個月下滑，房市疲弱，移民減少也對部分產業形成壓力。反對升息的經濟學家認為，排除波動項目的核心通膨仍約2%，此時緊縮可能妨礙溫和復甦。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場經濟學家Andrew Grantham預期，核心通膨不會如央行擔憂般加速，政策利率應無須升破2.75%。Servus Credit Union首席經濟學家Charles St-Arnaud則認為，除非經濟轉弱或通膨低於預期，否則12月仍可能再升息。
決策公布後，加幣變動不大，約報1美元兌1.405加幣。加拿大央行下次利率決策訂於12月9日。
paras_en: The Bank of Canada announced on Wednesday (the 28th) that it is raising its policy overnight rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 2.5%, its first hike since July 2023 and in line with market expectations. The bank warned that the Middle‑East conflict is pushing up energy prices, which could spill over into other goods and services, and that further rate hikes may be needed, but it will act cautiously given economic and geopolitical uncertainties.

To curb the spread of higher energy costs and bring inflation back to target by 2028, Governor Tiff Macklem said that the inflation outlook has risen sharply and, combined with a resilient economy, makes a rate increase necessary to reduce the risk that rising energy prices turn into broad‑based inflation. The policy committee sees rising inflation risks and a shrinking scope for accommodative policy.

Canada’s September inflation rate rose to 3.2%, above the bank’s 1‑3% target range, driven mainly by energy and related transport costs. The bank projects inflation will reach 3.5% by year‑end and stay around 3% for most of next year, only returning to near‑2% by mid‑2028.

At the same time, the bank lifted its 2027 average inflation forecast from the July estimate of 2% to 3.1%. Macklem noted that past experience and business surveys suggest cost‑pass‑through will increase over the next year, making the impact of energy price hikes on inflation more persistent.

However, the committee also discussed keeping rates unchanged, citing that price pressures remain concentrated in energy, there is still idle capacity in the economy, and the US‑Canada tariff dispute could weigh on growth. Macklem stressed that policy will be assessed at each meeting and no commitment to consecutive hikes has been made.

The bank upgraded its economic outlook, raising this year’s growth forecast from 0.7% to 1% and lifting the 2027 and 2028 forecasts from 1.8% to 2%. Federal productivity‑investment tax credits and major infrastructure projects are cited as part of the growth support.

Short‑term momentum may still slow. The bank expects annualised growth to fall from 3.3% in Q2 to 2% in Q3 and to 0.8% in Q4, reflecting the impact of new US tariffs. Macklem expects momentum to recover in 2027 as consumer spending continues, exports rebound and business investment picks up, gradually absorbing idle capacity.

Nevertheless, Canadian employment has declined for two consecutive months, the housing market is weak, and reduced immigration is pressuring some sectors. Economists opposed to rate hikes argue that core inflation, stripped of volatile items, remains around 2%, and tightening now could hinder a modest recovery.

CIBC capital‑markets economist Andrew Grantham expects core inflation will not accelerate as the bank fears and that the policy rate need not rise above 2.75%. Servus Credit Union chief economist Charles St‑Arnaud believes another hike is still possible in December unless the economy weakens or inflation falls short of expectations.
After the decision, the Canadian dollar moved little, quoted at roughly 1 USD = 1.405 CAD. The Bank of Canada’s next rate decision is scheduled for December 9.

items.title: 紐西蘭央行意外按兵不動 維持利率於2.75% 委員會意見分歧
items.title_en: New Zealand Central Bank Unexpectedly Holds Rate at 2.75% Amid Committee Split
paras: 紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)周三(28日)出乎市場意料，決定將官方現金利率(OCR)維持在 2.75% 不變。在媒體調查的 25 位經濟學家當中，僅有 2 位預期利率將維持不動，其餘多數專家均預估央行會升息 1 碼(25 個基點)。
決策公布後，紐元兌美元一度重挫 1.7%(跌至 55.86 美分)，紐西蘭基準股指 NZX 50 下跌 0.5%，對政策敏感的 2 年期政府公債殖利率則下滑 12 個基點至 3.82%。
根據央行公布的會議紀錄，貨幣政策委員會(MPC)最終以 4 比 3 的微幅差距通過按兵不動的決議。委員Paul Conway、Hayley Gourley與Karen Silk投票支持升息 1 碼至 3.00%；然而包含總裁Anna Breman與Prasanna Gai在內的 4 位委員則選擇維持利率不變。
主張暫緩升息者指出，當前經濟復甦步調脆弱，特別是家庭消費與投資意願低迷，且全球地緣政治與經濟環境突變的風險升高，因此宜採取觀望態度。
紐西蘭央行總裁 Breman表示：「在本次會議中，我們認為符合先前溝通方針是適當的，即維持基準利率不變，並持續釋出未來幾次會議極可能進一步升息的訊號。」
針對紐元下挫對通膨的影響，Breman補充說明：「當面對通膨壓力時，我們當然樂見紐元走強，但我們必須將其與影響中長期通膨的所有其他因素綜合權衡。因此我們正在密切觀察並謹慎評估其對未來通膨的影響。」
然而，這項決策遭到市場經濟學家的強烈質疑。Bank of New Zealand研究主管Stephen Toplis表示：「坦白說，我們對紐西蘭央行維持利率不變的決定感到大吃一驚。雖然央行並無義務跟隨市場定價或共識，但如此背道而馳極為罕見。央行此舉推動本已疲軟的紐元進一步下跌，瞬間加劇了通膨壓力。」
儘管紐西蘭 9 月季度消費者物價年增率已自前季的 4.1% 放緩至 3.7%，但仍高於央行設定的 1% 至 3% 目標區間。紐西蘭央行強調，若國內物價壓力未能有效緩解，後續會議仍不排除重新採取緊縮政策。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) on Wednesday (the 28th) surprised markets by deciding to keep the official cash rate (OCR) unchanged at 2.75%. Of the 25 economists surveyed by the media, only two expected the rate to stay steady, while the majority forecast a one‑point (25‑basis‑point) hike.

After the decision was announced, the New Zealand dollar fell as much as 1.7% against the U.S. dollar, sliding to US$0.5586, the NZX 50 index dropped 0.5%, and the policy‑sensitive two‑year government bond yield slipped 12 basis points to 3.82%.

According to the minutes released by the bank, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) approved the hold by a narrow 4‑to‑3 vote. Committee members Paul Conway, Hayley Gourley and Karen Silk voted for a one‑point increase to 3.00%, while four members, including Governor Anna Breman and Prasanna Gai, voted to keep the rate unchanged.

Those advocating a pause argued that the current economic recovery is fragile, especially with weak household consumption and investment appetite, and that the risk of sudden shifts in the global geopolitical and economic environment has risen, warranting a wait‑and‑see approach.

RBNZ Governor Breman said, "In this meeting we felt it was appropriate to follow our prior communication stance, namely to keep the policy rate unchanged while continuing to signal that future meetings are very likely to see further hikes."

Addressing the impact of the dollar’s decline on inflation, Breman added, "When faced with inflationary pressure we would of course welcome a stronger NZD, but we have to weigh that against all other factors affecting medium‑ to long‑term inflation. We are therefore monitoring closely and carefully assessing its effect on future inflation."

However, the decision was met with strong criticism from market economists. Stephen Toplis, research head at Bank of New Zealand, said, "Frankly, we were shocked by the RBNZ’s decision to hold rates. While the bank is not obliged to follow market pricing or consensus, such a divergence is extremely rare. The move pushes an already weak NZD even lower, instantly amplifying inflation pressures."

Even though New Zealand’s September quarterly CPI annual growth slowed from 4.1% in the prior quarter to 3.7%, it remains above the bank’s 1%‑3% target range. The RBNZ stressed that if domestic price pressures do not ease effectively, future meetings could still see a return to tightening.

items.title: 〈台幣〉央行重申柳樹理論 量縮觀望升值3.4分收在32.418元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar: Central Bank Reaffirms Willow‑Tree Theory, Reduced Volume, Cautious, Gains 3.4 cents to Close at 32.418
paras: 新台幣今(28)日量縮呈現小幅區間整理，終場收在32.418元，升值3.4分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值縮至17.03億美元。
新台幣今日以32.44元、升值1.2分開出後，一度貶至32.498元，盤中呈現升貶互見，午盤過後全面走升，最高見到32.398元，全日高低價差僅1角。
觀察主要亞幣，日元升逾0.1%，新台幣收升0.1%，人民幣處平盤左右，泰銖和星元貶0.05%左右，韓元則是重挫近1%。
中央銀行總裁楊金龍今日在立院備詢時強調，央行面對匯市一向採「柳樹理論」，讓匯率適度擺動，出現異常波動或失序時，基於維持金融穩定立場下會調節，以防波動過大。
統一投顧指出，中東外交出現轉機，油價回落，再加上 Meta 發行案獲 5 倍超額認購，帶動美股反彈，市場等待本周聯準會利率決策和CSP大廠財報，同時，台股短線負乖離大、技術指標落入超賣區，本周尚有聯發科、台達電、聯電等電子大廠法說會以及鴻海科技日等，有利於反彈。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed a modest range‑bound contraction today (28th), closing at 32.418 per US $, a gain of 3.4 cents, while transaction volume at a Taipei FX brokerage fell to $1.703 billion.

The dollar opened at 32.44, up 1.2 cents, then slipped to 32.498 before fluctuating intraday; after the lunch break it rallied steadily, touching a high of 32.398, with the day's high‑low spread limited to just one tenth of a unit.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen rose more than 0.1%, the New Taiwan dollar gained 0.1%, the Chinese yuan stayed roughly flat, the Thai baht and Singapore dollar each fell about 0.05%, while the Korean won plunged nearly 1%.

Central Bank Governor Yang Jin‑long emphasized in a legislative hearing that the bank always applies the “willow‑tree theory” to allow exchange rates to move moderately, and will intervene to maintain financial stability if abnormal or disorderly swings occur.

Unified Investment Research noted that a diplomatic breakthrough in the Middle East and a pull‑back in oil prices, combined with Meta’s offering being oversubscribed five‑fold, sparked a rebound in US equities. Markets await this week’s Fed rate decision and major CSP earnings; meanwhile, Taiwan’s market shows a short‑term negative divergence and technical indicators in oversold territory, but upcoming earnings calls from MediaTek, Delta Electronics, UMC and Foxconn’s Tech Day could support a bounce.
